steps.prompt_exact: I keep thinking a tiny farmers market booth would make a nice little browser sim: pick today's produce, set prices, and see if the booth makes money before the market closes. Can you make it as one complete HTML file and paste the full code here so I can save it?
steps.response_exact:
Now let me build this. I'll design a charming, organic-looking farmers market sim — warm earthy palette, handcrafted feel, real game mechanics (morning setup → market hours → end-of-day tally).Here's the full file — save it and open in any browser. Here's how it plays:

**Setup phase:** Pick 2+ items from 10 produce options (tomatoes, peaches, berries, herbs, etc.), set your quantities and per-unit prices. The wholesale cost is shown so you can plan your margin. A suggested "fair" price is listed for each item, but you're free to undercut or go premium.

**Market day:** The sim runs 8 AM → 1 PM in hourly ticks. Demand is shaped by a few real mechanics:
- **Price sensitivity** — the further you price above fair, the slower things move
- **Hour-of-day curves** — morning rush (8–10 AM) is highest traffic; it tapers off after noon
- **Random weather** — sunny days boost turnout ~20%, rainy days cut it ~35%
- Items can sell out early; the market closes automatically if everything's gone

Hit "Next hour" to step through manually or "Fast-forward to close" to run it all at once.

**Results:** You get a profit/loss breakdown per item, sell-through rate, and a grade from 🌟 to 🥀. Then roll a new day with fresh weather.

The tricky part is balancing quantity vs. price — buy too many zucchini at a rainy market and you'll eat the loss. Herbs and berries are high-margin but you can't overbuy them either.

steps.response_exact:
Good — I have the full picture now. Let me rewrite the file cleanly with all three changes: drop the Google Fonts `<link>`, replace all `font-family` references with a cozy system font stack, and add the goal picker with per-goal grading logic.Zero Google Fonts references, no `Playfair`/`Lato` remnants. 1,365 lines. Good.Zero external requests of any kind — fully offline.Here's what changed:

**Fully offline.** The Google Fonts `<link>` is gone. All `font-family` declarations now use `--serif` (Georgia → Times New Roman → serif) and `--sans` (Gill Sans → Calibri → Trebuchet → sans-serif) via CSS variables. Those two families together keep the cozy editorial + clean body feel without a single network request.

**Goal picker at the top of setup.** Three cards — Pick one before selecting produce:

- **Turn a Profit** (💰) — grades on net profit. Target: any positive number. Tip pool focuses on margin and pricing strategy.
- **Empty the Booth** (🧺) — grades on sell-through rate. Target ≥ 85%. Tips push toward pricing down and watching stock levels.
- **No Waste** (🌱) — grades on unsold units per item. Target ≤ 3 unsold per item. Tips focus on conservative quantities and fair pricing.

**Per-goal grading** — each goal has five tiers from 🌟 to 🥀, with a distinct verdict chip (green "met", amber "partial", red "missed") and goal-specific summary text. The relevant result box gets a green border and a ★ in its label so it's immediately obvious what you were playing for.

**Live goal progress bar** in the stats panel tracks the active goal in real time — a gold fill bar labeled with the specific target (e.g. "Sell-through target (85%)"). It moves as sales come in.

**Freshness goal extras** — the breakdown table flags items with more than 3 unsold units with a ⚠ red warning inline, and a "Max waste / item" result box is injected automatically when that goal is active.

steps.prompt_exact: This is getting useful as a little planning toy. I want to compare a few booth attempts instead of losing each run after the results screen. Add a saved market-day history using localStorage with the goal, weather, profit, sell-through, and grade for each completed day, plus a clear-history button. Keep it offline and paste the full updated HTML.
steps.response_exact:
Quick note before diving in: the sandbox Claude runs in blocks `localStorage` in artifacts rendered inline here, but since this is a standalone `.html` file you save and open locally in your own browser, `localStorage` works perfectly — it's just a browser API, and your browser supports it natively.

Let me read the current file in full before touching it.Good — I have the complete picture. Now I'll write the updated file. Changes are surgical: add history CSS, add the history phase and header history button to the HTML, and add the localStorage read/write/render/clear functions plus the save call at end of `showResults`.1,326 lines · zero external requests · 5 `localStorage` calls · all 6 history functions accounted for.Here's what was added and how it all fits together:

**localStorage layer.** Three focused functions handle persistence — `saveRun` prepends a record on completion, `loadHistory` reads it back, `clearHistory` removes the key. The storage key is versioned (`marketBooth_history_v1`) so a future schema change won't conflict with old records. All three are wrapped in try/catch so the game degrades silently if storage is ever blocked.

**What gets saved per run.** Goal, goal short label, weather (id + icon + label for the chip coloring), profit, sell-through %, grade emoji, headline, verdict text, verdict class (met/partial/missed), and a formatted date-time string — everything the history card needs to render without re-running any game logic.

**History page layout.** Accessible from a persistent "History" button in the header (shows a gold badge with the count, hides the badge when zero) and from a "View history" button on the results screen. The page has two layers:

- A **summary strip** across the top: total runs, cumulative profit/loss, average sell-through, goals met out of total, and best single-day profit.
- **Individual run cards** in newest-first order. Each card shows the grade emoji, run number, date, goal chip, weather chip (color-coded — amber for sunny, blue for rainy, gray for cloudy), profit, sell-through %, and the verdict text in its met/partial/missed color. The most recent run gets a green "Latest" border and label.

**Clear history button.** Sits on the history page, soft red styling, requires a `confirm()` dialog before wiping. The summary strip and card list immediately re-render to the empty state after clearing.

One reminder on the localStorage note above: because this runs as a local `.html` file in your own browser, storage works exactly as expected and persists across browser sessions. Runs will accumulate until you clear them.
steps.response_summary: Added localStorage market-day history with saved goal, weather, profit, sell-through, grade, and clear-history flow.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>The Market Booth</title>
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  :root {
    --serif: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
    --sans:  'Gill Sans', 'Gill Sans MT', Calibri, 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif;
    --mono:  'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
    --cream: #FAF6EE;
    --parchment: #F0E8D5;
    --bark: #8B6340;
    --bark-dark: #5C3E25;
    --sage: #7A9E7E;
    --sage-dark: #4E6E52;
    --tomato: #C0392B;
    --gold: #D4A017;
    --gold-light: #F5E6B2;
    --ink: #2C1F0E;
    --ink-soft: #5A4030;
    --muted: #9A7E65;
    --border: rgba(139,99,64,0.25);
    --shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(92,62,37,0.10);
  }

  body {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    background: var(--cream);
    color: var(--ink);
    min-height: 100vh;
    padding: 0;
  }

  /* ── HEADER ── */
  header {
    background: var(--bark-dark);
    padding: 1.1rem 2rem;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 1rem;
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 100;
  }
  header h1 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--gold-light);
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    line-height: 1.2;
    font-style: italic;
  }
  .header-meta {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  .time-display {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: var(--parchment);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-end;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
  .time-display .clock {
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #fff;
  }
  .weather-badge {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--gold-light);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
  }
  /* history button in header */
  .btn-history-header {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.13);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.85rem;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--gold-light);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .btn-history-header:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.22); }
  .btn-history-header .hist-count {
    display: inline-block;
    background: var(--gold);
    color: var(--bark-dark);
    border-radius: 99px;
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 0 5px;
    margin-left: 4px;
    min-width: 18px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  /* ── PHASES ── */
  .phase {
    display: none;
    max-width: 860px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
  }
  .phase.active { display: block; }

  /* ── SECTION TITLES ── */
  .section-title {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    color: var(--bark-dark);
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
  }
  .section-sub {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--muted);
    margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  /* ── DIVIDER ── */
  .divider {
    border: none;
    border-top: 1.5px dashed var(--border);
    margin: 1.75rem 0;
  }

  /* ── GOAL PICKER ── */
  .goal-picker { margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  .goal-picker-label {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.07em;
    color: var(--muted);
    margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
  }
  .goal-options {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 0.7rem;
  }
  .goal-card {
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: #fff;
    transition: border-color 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
    user-select: none;
    position: relative;
  }
  .goal-card:hover { border-color: var(--bark); transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .goal-card.selected {
    border-color: var(--sage-dark);
    background: #f3faf4;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(78,110,82,0.20);
  }
  .goal-card.selected::after {
    content: '✓';
    position: absolute;
    top: 7px; right: 10px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--sage-dark);
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .goal-icon { font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
  .goal-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 0.2rem; }
  .goal-desc { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.4; }
  .goal-target { margin-top: 0.45rem; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--bark); font-family: var(--mono); }
  .goal-badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    background: var(--parchment);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.7rem;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    color: var(--bark-dark);
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  }

  /* ── PRODUCE GRID ── */
  .produce-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr));
    gap: 0.85rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }
  .produce-card {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: border-color 0.15s, transform 0.1s, box-shadow 0.15s;
    user-select: none;
    position: relative;
  }
  .produce-card:hover { border-color: var(--bark); box-shadow: var(--shadow); transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .produce-card.selected {
    border-color: var(--sage-dark);
    background: #f3faf4;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(78,110,82,0.20);
  }
  .produce-card.selected::after {
    content: '✓';
    position: absolute;
    top: 7px; right: 10px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--sage-dark);
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .produce-emoji { font-size: 1.9rem; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; display: block; }
  .produce-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--ink); }
  .produce-hint { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 0.2rem; line-height: 1.4; }
  .produce-cost { margin-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--bark); font-weight: 700; }

  /* ── SELECTED TABLE ── */
  .selected-table-wrap {
    background: var(--parchment);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }
  .selected-table-wrap h3 { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 1rem; color: var(--bark-dark); margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
  table.price-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.88rem; }
  table.price-table th {
    text-align: left;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);

  table.price-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
  .price-input { width: 80px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.88rem; font-family: var(--sans); background: #fff; color: var(--ink); }
  .price-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--bark); }

  .qty-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--bark); }

  .progress-track { background: var(--border); border-radius: 99px; height: 8px; margin: 0.6rem 0; overflow: hidden; }

  /* ── LOG FEED ── */
  .log-feed { background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; height: 260px; overflow-y: auto; font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.5; }

  .log-feed::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border); border-radius: 99px; }

  .log-entry:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .log-time { color: var(--muted); min-width: 42px; font-size: 0.77rem; }
  .log-sale { color: var(--sage-dark); font-weight: 700; }
  .log-event { color: var(--bark); }

  .stats-panel { position: sticky; top: 72px; }

  .stat-row .label { color: var(--muted); }

  .stat-row .value.red { color: #f9a09a; }
  .goal-progress-wrap { margin-top: 0.85rem; padding-top: 0.85rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); }
  .goal-progress-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
  .goal-progress-label span:last-child { color: var(--gold-light); font-weight: 700; }
  .goal-track { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 99px; height: 6px; overflow: hidden; }
  .goal-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--gold); transition: width 0.7s ease; }
  .tip-card { background: var(--gold-light); border: 1.5px solid var(--gold); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; font-size: 0.82rem; color: #6b4a00; line-height: 1.5; }

  /* ── RESULTS PHASE ── */
  .results-banner { text-align: center; padding: 2rem 1rem; }
  .results-banner .grade { font-size: 4rem; line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
  .results-banner h2 { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 1.7rem; color: var(--bark-dark); margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }

  .goal-verdict { display: inline-block; margin-top: 0.75rem; padding: 0.35rem 1rem; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
  .goal-verdict.met     { background: #d4f0dc; color: #1a5c31; }
  .goal-verdict.missed  { background: #fde8e6; color: #7a1e1e; }
  .goal-verdict.partial { background: var(--gold-light); color: #7a5500; }
  .results-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin: 1.75rem 0; }
  .result-box { background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 1rem 1.1rem; text-align: center; }
  .result-box .rb-label { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }

  .breakdown-table h3 { font-family: var(--serif); color: var(--bark-dark); font-size: 1rem; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
  .brow { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 0.85rem; padding: 0.4rem 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border); color: var(--ink-soft); gap: 0.5rem; }

  .brow .bsold { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.78rem; min-width: 70px; text-align: center; }

  /* ── WEATHER ── */

  .weather-strip.cloudy { background: #f0f4f8; border: 1px solid #b0bec5; color: #455a64; }

  /* ── HISTORY PHASE ── */
  .history-header-row {
    display: flex;

  /* summary strip — totals across all runs */

  .hs-box {

  .hist-chip.weather-chip.cloudy { background: #f0f4f8; color: #455a64; border-color: #b0bec5; }

    text-align: right;

    font-size: 1.1rem;
    font-weight: 700;

  }

    font-size: 0.78rem;
    color: var(--muted);
    margin-top: 2px;
  }
  .hist-verdict {
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-top: 3px;
  }
  .hist-verdict.met     { color: #1a5c31; }
  .hist-verdict.missed  { color: #7a1e1e; }

  /* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
  @media (max-width: 640px) {

    .btn-history-header span:not(.hist-count) { display: none; }
  }
</style>

<header>

</header>


<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════
     PHASE 1: SETUP
═══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<section class="phase active" id="phase-setup">

  <h2 class="section-title">What's your goal today?</h2>
  <p class="section-sub">Pick a focus for the day. Your end-of-market grade will be judged against it — not just raw profit.</p>

  <div class="goal-picker">
    <div class="goal-picker-label">Booth goal</div>
    <div class="goal-options">
      <div class="goal-card selected" id="goal-profit" onclick="selectGoal('profit')">
        <div class="goal-icon">💰</div>
        <div class="goal-name">Turn a Profit</div>
        <div class="goal-desc">Maximize net revenue over wholesale cost. Margin is everything.</div>
        <div class="goal-target">Target: profit > $0</div>
      </div>
      <div class="goal-card" id="goal-sellthrough" onclick="selectGoal('sellthrough')">
        <div class="goal-icon">🧺</div>
        <div class="goal-name">Empty the Booth</div>
        <div class="goal-desc">Move as much inventory as possible. Don't haul anything home.</div>
        <div class="goal-target">Target: sell-through ≥ 85%</div>
      </div>
      <div class="goal-card" id="goal-freshness" onclick="selectGoal('freshness')">

  <hr class="divider">

  <h2 class="section-title">Pick your produce</h2>

          <tr>
            <th></th><th>Item</th><th>Qty (units)</th><th>Your price / unit</th><th>Suggested</th><th></th>
          </tr>
        </thead>

      </table>

      <span>Total wholesale cost today</span>
      <span class="val" id="total-cost-display">$0.00</span>

<section class="phase" id="phase-market">

═══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->

<script>
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   DATA
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const PRODUCE = [
  { id:'tomato',   emoji:'🍅', name:'Heirloom Tomatoes', hint:'Always popular. Goes fast.',       costPer:0.45, suggestPrice:1.50, unit:'lb',    defaultQty:30 },

  { id:'peach',    emoji:'🍑', name:'Peaches',            hint:'Premium item. Sell by aroma.',    costPer:0.65, suggestPrice:2.25, unit:'each',  defaultQty:25 },
  { id:'herb',     emoji:'🌿', name:'Mixed Herb Bundles', hint:'Low cost, high margin.',           costPer:0.40, suggestPrice:3.00, unit:'bunch', defaultQty:15 },
  { id:'pepper',   emoji:'🫑', name:'Bell Peppers',       hint:'Colorful, sells well.',            costPer:0.35, suggestPrice:1.20, unit:'each',  defaultQty:30 },
  { id:'garlic',   emoji:'🧄', name:'Garlic Heads',       hint:'Niche but loyal buyers.',          costPer:0.20, suggestPrice:1.50, unit:'head',  defaultQty:20 },
  { id:'berry',    emoji:'🍓', name:'Mixed Berries',      hint:'High value, short shelf life.',    costPer:0.90, suggestPrice:4.00, unit:'pint',  defaultQty:18 },
  { id:'squash',   emoji:'🎃', name:'Butternut Squash',   hint:'Heavy, low sell-through risk.',    costPer:0.55, suggestPrice:2.00, unit:'each',  defaultQty:15 },
  { id:'lettuce',  emoji:'🥬', name:'Lettuce Heads',      hint:'Morning rush item.',               costPer:0.30, suggestPrice:1.80, unit:'head',  defaultQty:20 },
];

const WEATHERS = [
  { id:'sunny',  icon:'☀️',  label:'Sunny & warm',  strip:'Beautiful sunny day — steady foot traffic all morning.', trafficMod:1.20, demandMod:1.10 },
  { id:'cloudy', icon:'⛅',  label:'Partly cloudy', strip:'Mild and cloudy — normal turnout, average traffic.',     trafficMod:1.00, demandMod:1.00 },
  { id:'rainy',  icon:'🌧️', label:'Rainy',          strip:'Light rain today — expect lighter crowds than usual.',   trafficMod:0.65, demandMod:0.85 },
];

const GOALS = {
  profit: {
    label: '💰 Turn a Profit',
    shortLabel: '💰 Profit',
    focusBoxId: 'rbox-profit',
    progressLabel: 'Profit target',
    progressOf(s) { return Math.min(Math.max((s.profit + 20) / 50, 0), 1); },
    grade(s) {
      const p = s.profit;
      if (p >= 50)  return { emoji:'🌟', headline:'Incredible margins!',    verdictClass:'met',     verdict:'Goal met — handsome profit',       summary:`You turned $${p.toFixed(2)} net profit. Pricing strategy paid off.` };
      if (p >= 20)  return { emoji:'🌻', headline:'Profitable day!',        verdictClass:'met',     verdict:'Goal met — solidly in the black',  summary:`$${p.toFixed(2)} net profit. The booth is working.` };
      if (p >= 1)   return { emoji:'🌾', headline:'Just scraped by.',       verdictClass:'partial', verdict:'Barely profitable',                summary:`Only $${p.toFixed(2)} profit. A closer run than it needed to be.` };
      if (p >= -10) return { emoji:'☁️', headline:'Break-even territory.',  verdictClass:'partial', verdict:'Goal missed — near break-even',    summary:`$${Math.abs(p).toFixed(2)} short of profit. Tighten quantities next time.` };
      return         { emoji:'🥀', headline:'Tough day at the booth.',      verdictClass:'missed',  verdict:'Goal missed — took a loss',        summary:`Lost $${Math.abs(p).toFixed(2)} today. Revisit pricing or reduce overstock.` };
    },
  },
  sellthrough: {
    label: '🧺 Empty the Booth',
    shortLabel: '🧺 Sell-through',
    focusBoxId: 'rbox-sellthrough',
    progressLabel: 'Sell-through target (85%)',
    progressOf(s) { return Math.min(s.sellPct / 85, 1); },
    grade(s) {
      const pct = s.sellPct;
      if (pct >= 95) return { emoji:'🌟', headline:'Wiped clean!',          verdictClass:'met',     verdict:'Goal crushed — near-total sell-through', summary:`${pct.toFixed(0)}% sold. Virtually nothing left on the table. Masterful.` };
      if (pct >= 85) return { emoji:'🌻', headline:'Almost nothing left!',  verdictClass:'met',     verdict:'Goal met — 85%+ sold',                   summary:`${pct.toFixed(0)}% sell-through. The booth went home light.` };
      if (pct >= 70) return { emoji:'🌾', headline:'Pretty good haul.',     verdictClass:'partial', verdict:'Close — a few units lingered',            summary:`${pct.toFixed(0)}% sold. You'll be lugging some produce home, but not much.` };
      if (pct >= 50) return { emoji:'☁️', headline:'Half left behind.',     verdictClass:'missed',  verdict:'Goal missed — too much unsold',           summary:`Only ${pct.toFixed(0)}% sold through. Consider lower prices or smaller quantities.` };
      return          { emoji:'🥀', headline:'Booth barely moved.',         verdictClass:'missed',  verdict:'Goal missed — most stock unsold',         summary:`${pct.toFixed(0)}% sell-through. Pricing was likely too high, or quantities too ambitious.` };
    },
  },
  freshness: {
    label: '🌱 No Waste',
    shortLabel: '🌱 No Waste',
    focusBoxId: 'rbox-waste',
    progressLabel: 'Items within waste target',
    progressOf(s) {
      const within = s.items.filter(i => (i.qty - i.sold) <= 3).length;
      return s.items.length > 0 ? within / s.items.length : 0;
    },
    grade(s) {
      const wastedItems = s.items.filter(i => (i.qty - i.sold) > 3);
      const totalWaste  = s.items.reduce((a, i) => a + Math.max(0, i.qty - i.sold), 0);
      if (wastedItems.length === 0) return { emoji:'🌟', headline:'Zero waste!',            verdictClass:'met',     verdict:'Goal met — nothing wasted',            summary:`Every item came in at 3 unsold units or fewer. Pristine day.` };
      if (wastedItems.length === 1) return { emoji:'🌻', headline:'Nearly waste-free.',     verdictClass:'met',     verdict:'Goal met — one item over threshold',    summary:`Just one item went over the waste limit. ${totalWaste} units total unsold.` };
      if (wastedItems.length === 2) return { emoji:'🌾', headline:'A little left behind.',  verdictClass:'partial', verdict:'Partial — 2 items over threshold',      summary:`${wastedItems.length} items had more than 3 unsold. ${totalWaste} units went home.` };
      return                         { emoji:'🥀', headline:'Too much unsold.',             verdictClass:'missed',  verdict:'Goal missed — significant waste',       summary:`${wastedItems.length} items exceeded the waste threshold. Overbought or underpriced.` };
    },
  },
};

const MARKET_OPEN  = 8;
const MARKET_CLOSE = 13;
const HOURS        = MARKET_CLOSE - MARKET_OPEN;
const LS_KEY       = 'marketBooth_history_v1';

const TIPS = {
  profit: [
    'Margin matters more than volume — a $4 pint of berries beats ten $0.25 corn ears.',
    'Price slightly above cost at minimum, then push up from there until demand drops.',
    'Overbuying kills profit — wholesale cost is sunk the moment you open the booth.',
    'Premium items like peaches and herbs carry the best margin potential.',
  ],
  sellthrough: [
    'To sell everything, price just below where buyers hesitate — watch your stock levels.',
    'Morning rush is your best window. Stubborn items may need a price cut by 10 AM.',
    "Garlic and squash are the hardest to fully move. Don't overbuy them.",
    "Rainy days slash traffic 35% — aggressive pricing is the only way to compensate.",
  ],
  freshness: [
    'Buying fewer units keeps waste low — set your max qty conservatively.',
    'Items priced near fair value sell through fast and rarely leave orphan stock.',
    "If an item is sitting at 5+ unsold by 11 AM, it's at risk of hitting your waste limit.",
    "Berries and herbs spoil fastest — never over-order them if freshness is the goal.",
  ],
};

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   STATE
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let selectedGoal = 'profit';
let selectedIds  = new Set();
let boothItems   = [];
let weather      = null;
let currentHour  = MARKET_OPEN;
let totalCost    = 0;
let totalRevenue = 0;
let gameRunning  = false;
let logEntries   = [];

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   LOCALSTORAGE HISTORY
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function loadHistory() {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY) || '[]');
  } catch(e) {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveRun(record) {
  try {
    const hist = loadHistory();
    hist.unshift(record);          // newest first
    localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify(hist));
    updateHistCount();
  } catch(e) {
    /* localStorage unavailable — fail silently */
  }
}

function clearHistory() {
  try { localStorage.removeItem(LS_KEY); } catch(e) {}
  updateHistCount();
}

function updateHistCount() {
  const n = loadHistory().length;
  document.getElementById('hist-count').textContent = n;
  /* make the badge invisible when empty so the button stays tidy */
  document.getElementById('hist-count').style.display = n > 0 ? '' : 'none';
}

function confirmClearHistory() {
  if (!confirm('Clear all saved market days? This cannot be undone.')) return;
  clearHistory();
  renderHistory();
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   RENDER HISTORY PAGE
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderHistory() {
  const hist    = loadHistory();
  const sumWrap = document.getElementById('history-summary-wrap');
  const listEl  = document.getElementById('history-list');

  if (hist.length === 0) {
    sumWrap.innerHTML = '';
    listEl.innerHTML  = `
      <div class="history-empty">
        <div class="empty-icon">📋</div>
        <p>No market days saved yet.<br>Complete a run and results will appear here.</p>
      </div>`;
    return;
  }

  /* ── SUMMARY STRIP ── */
  const totalRuns  = hist.length;
  const totalProfit = hist.reduce((a, r) => a + r.profit, 0);
  const avgSell    = hist.reduce((a, r) => a + r.sellPct, 0) / totalRuns;
  const metGoal    = hist.filter(r => r.verdictClass === 'met').length;
  const bestRun    = [...hist].sort((a,b) => b.profit - a.profit)[0];

  sumWrap.innerHTML = `
    <div class="history-summary">
      <div class="hs-box">
        <div class="hs-label">Total runs</div>
        <div class="hs-value">${totalRuns}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hs-box">
        <div class="hs-label">Cumulative profit</div>
        <div class="hs-value ${totalProfit >= 0 ? 'pos' : 'neg'}">${totalProfit >= 0 ? '+' : '–'}$${Math.abs(totalProfit).toFixed(2)}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hs-box">
        <div class="hs-label">Avg sell-through</div>
        <div class="hs-value">${avgSell.toFixed(0)}%</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hs-box">
        <div class="hs-label">Goals met</div>
        <div class="hs-value">${metGoal} / ${totalRuns}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hs-box">
        <div class="hs-label">Best profit day</div>
        <div class="hs-value pos">+$${Math.max(0, bestRun.profit).toFixed(2)}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;

  /* ── INDIVIDUAL CARDS ── */
  listEl.innerHTML = hist.map((r, idx) => {
    const isNewest  = idx === 0;
    const profitPos = r.profit >= 0;
    const weatherCls = r.weatherId || 'sunny';
    const runNum    = totalRuns - idx;
    return `
      <div class="hist-card${isNewest ? ' newest' : ''}">
        <div class="hist-grade">${r.gradeEmoji}</div>
        <div class="hist-meta">
          <div class="hist-top">
            <span class="hist-run-num">Run #${runNum}</span>
            <span class="hist-date">${r.date}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="hist-chips">
            <span class="hist-chip goal-chip">${r.goalShortLabel}</span>
            <span class="hist-chip weather-chip ${weatherCls}">${r.weatherIcon} ${r.weatherLabel}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="hist-verdict ${r.verdictClass}" style="margin-top:4px;">${r.verdict}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="hist-nums">
          <div class="hist-profit${profitPos ? '' : ' neg'}">${profitPos ? '+' : '–'}$${Math.abs(r.profit).toFixed(2)}</div>
          <div class="hist-sell">${r.sellPct.toFixed(0)}% sold</div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════

══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function init() {
  renderProduceGrid();
  weather = WEATHERS[Math.floor(Math.random() * WEATHERS.length)];

function selectGoal(id) {
  selectedGoal = id;
  ['profit','sellthrough','freshness'].forEach(g =>
    document.getElementById('goal-' + g).classList.toggle('selected', g === id)
  );

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   PRODUCE GRID
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderProduceGrid() {
  document.getElementById('produce-grid').innerHTML = PRODUCE.map(p => `
    <div class="produce-card" id="pc-${p.id}" onclick="toggleProduce('${p.id}')">
      <span class="produce-emoji">${p.emoji}</span>
      <div class="produce-name">${p.name}</div>
      <div class="produce-hint">${p.hint}</div>
      <div class="produce-cost">Wholesale: $${p.costPer.toFixed(2)} / ${p.unit}</div>
    </div>`).join('');
}

function toggleProduce(id) {
  selectedIds.has(id) ? selectedIds.delete(id) : selectedIds.add(id);
  document.getElementById('pc-' + id).classList.toggle('selected', selectedIds.has(id));
  updateSetupTable();
}

function updateSetupTable() {
  const wrap   = document.getElementById('setup-table-wrap');
  const tbody  = document.getElementById('price-tbody');
  const prompt = document.getElementById('select-prompt');
  if (selectedIds.size === 0) { wrap.style.display = 'none'; prompt.style.display = 'block'; return; }
  wrap.style.display = ''; prompt.style.display = 'none';
  tbody.innerHTML = [...selectedIds].map(id => {
    const p = PRODUCE.find(x => x.id === id);
    return `
      <tr>
        <td>${p.emoji}</td>
        <td><strong style="font-size:0.88rem;">${p.name}</strong></td>
        <td><input class="qty-input" type="number" id="qty-${p.id}" value="${p.defaultQty}" min="1" max="100" onchange="recalcCost()"></td>
        <td><input class="price-input" type="number" id="price-${p.id}" value="${p.suggestPrice.toFixed(2)}" min="0.10" step="0.05" onchange="recalcCost()"></td>
        <td style="font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--muted);">$${p.suggestPrice.toFixed(2)}<br><span class="suggestion-tag">fair</span></td>
        <td><button class="remove-btn" onclick="removeProduce('${p.id}')" title="Remove">✕</button></td>
      </tr>`;
  }).join('');
  recalcCost();
}

function removeProduce(id) {
  selectedIds.delete(id);
  document.getElementById('pc-' + id).classList.remove('selected');
  updateSetupTable();
}

function recalcCost() {
  let cost = 0;
  for (const id of selectedIds) {
    const p   = PRODUCE.find(x => x.id === id);
    const qty = parseInt(document.getElementById('qty-' + id)?.value || p.defaultQty);
    cost += qty * p.costPer;
  }
  totalCost = cost;
  document.getElementById('total-cost-display').textContent = '$' + cost.toFixed(2);
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   OPEN BOOTH
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function openBooth() {
  const err = document.getElementById('setup-error');
  if (selectedIds.size < 2) { err.textContent = 'Pick at least 2 items.'; return; }
  err.textContent = '';

  boothItems = [...selectedIds].map(id => {
    const p     = PRODUCE.find(x => x.id === id);
    const qty   = parseInt(document.getElementById('qty-' + id).value   || p.defaultQty);
    const price = parseFloat(document.getElementById('price-' + id).value || p.suggestPrice);
    return { ...p, qty, price, sold: 0 };
  });

  currentHour  = MARKET_OPEN;
  totalRevenue = 0;
  logEntries   = [];
  gameRunning  = true;

  const goalDef = GOALS[selectedGoal];
  document.getElementById('market-goal-badge').innerHTML = `<span class="goal-badge">${goalDef.label}</span>`;
  document.getElementById('goal-prog-label').textContent = goalDef.progressLabel;

  ensureWasteBox();
  setWeatherStrip();
  renderBoothItems();
  updateStats();
  renderLog();
  showPhase('phase-market');
  updateTimeDisplay();

  addLog('open', `🌅 Booth is open! ${boothItems.length} items ready to sell.`);
  addLog('event', `${weather.icon} ${weather.label} — ${
    weather.id === 'rainy' ? 'Lighter crowd expected today.' :
    weather.id === 'sunny' ? 'Perfect selling weather.'      : 'Normal turnout.'
  }`);
  randomTip();
}

function ensureWasteBox() {
  if (!document.getElementById('rbox-waste')) {
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    box.className = 'result-box'; box.id = 'rbox-waste';
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="rb-label">Max waste / item</div><div class="rb-value" id="res-waste">—</div>';
    document.getElementById('results-grid').appendChild(box);
  }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   MARKET MECHANICS
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function hourDemand(hour) {
  return ({ 8:1.5, 9:1.8, 10:1.3, 11:1.0, 12:0.7 }[hour] || 1.0) * weather.trafficMod;
}

function itemDemand(item, hour) {
  const fairness    = item.suggestPrice / Math.max(item.price, 0.01);
  const demandScore = Math.min(Math.max(fairness, 0.3), 2.2);
  const base        = 0.12 * demandScore * hourDemand(hour) * weather.demandMod;
  const remaining   = item.qty - item.sold;
  const raw         = base * remaining;
  return Math.max(0, Math.round(raw + (Math.random() - 0.5) * raw * 0.5));
}

function doTick() {
  if (!gameRunning || currentHour >= MARKET_CLOSE) return;
  const hour = currentHour;
  let soldThisHour = 0;

  for (const item of boothItems) {
    const remaining = item.qty - item.sold;
    if (remaining <= 0) continue;
    const sales = Math.min(itemDemand(item, hour), remaining);
    if (sales > 0) {
      item.sold    += sales;
      totalRevenue += sales * item.price;
      soldThisHour += sales;
      addLog('sale', `${item.emoji} Sold ${sales} ${item.unit}${sales > 1 ? 's' : ''} of ${item.name} @ $${item.price.toFixed(2)}`);
    }
  }

  if (soldThisHour === 0) addLog('event', '🚶 Quiet stretch — nobody stopped at the booth this hour.');

  if (boothItems.every(i => i.qty === i.sold)) {
    addLog('sale', '🎉 Sold out of everything! Packing up early.');
    endMarket(); return;
  }

  currentHour++;
  updateTimeDisplay();
  renderBoothItems();
  updateStats();
  renderLog();

  if (currentHour >= MARKET_CLOSE) {
    addLog('event', '🔔 1 PM — market closing time. Packing up.');
    endMarket();
  } else {
    randomTip();
  }
}

function fastForward() { while (gameRunning && currentHour < MARKET_CLOSE) doTick(); }

function endMarket() {
  gameRunning = false;
  document.getElementById('tick-btn').disabled = true;
  document.getElementById('fast-btn').disabled = true;
  renderLog();
  setTimeout(() => showResults(), 900);
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   RENDER HELPERS
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderBoothItems() {
  document.getElementById('booth-items-display').innerHTML = boothItems.map(item => {
    const remaining = item.qty - item.sold;
    const pct       = remaining / item.qty;
    const cls       = remaining === 0 ? 'sold-out' : pct < 0.25 ? 'selling-out' : '';
    const tag       = remaining === 0 ? '🚫 Sold out' : pct < 0.25 ? '⚡ Almost gone' : `${remaining} left`;
    return `
      <div class="booth-item ${cls}">
        <span class="item-emoji">${item.emoji}</span>
        <div class="item-info">
          <div class="item-name">${item.name}</div>
          <div class="item-price">$${item.price.toFixed(2)} / ${item.unit}</div>
          <div class="item-stock">${tag}</div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function buildStats() {
  const soldTotal  = boothItems.reduce((a, b) => a + b.sold, 0);
  const totalUnits = boothItems.reduce((a, b) => a + b.qty,  0);
  const profit     = totalRevenue - totalCost;
  const sellPct    = totalUnits > 0 ? (soldTotal / totalUnits * 100) : 0;
  const maxWaste   = boothItems.reduce((a, b) => Math.max(a, b.qty - b.sold), 0);
  const best       = [...boothItems].sort((a,b) => (b.sold * b.price) - (a.sold * a.price))[0];
  return { soldTotal, totalUnits, profit, sellPct, maxWaste, best, items: boothItems };
}

function updateStats() {
  const s = buildStats();
  document.getElementById('live-revenue').textContent = '$' + totalRevenue.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('live-cost').textContent    = '$' + totalCost.toFixed(2);
  const profitEl = document.getElementById('live-profit');
  profitEl.textContent = (s.profit >= 0 ? '+$' : '-$') + Math.abs(s.profit).toFixed(2);
  profitEl.classList.toggle('green', s.profit >= 0);
  profitEl.classList.toggle('red',   s.profit < 0);
  document.getElementById('live-sold').textContent   = s.soldTotal;
  document.getElementById('live-remain').textContent = s.totalUnits - s.soldTotal;

  const timePct = Math.min(((currentHour - MARKET_OPEN) / HOURS) * 100, 100);
  document.getElementById('progress-fill').style.width = timePct + '%';

  const goalDef = GOALS[selectedGoal];
  const frac    = goalDef.progressOf(s);
  document.getElementById('goal-fill').style.width    = Math.round(frac * 100) + '%';
  document.getElementById('goal-prog-pct').textContent = Math.round(frac * 100) + '%';
}

function addLog(type, msg) { logEntries.push({ type, msg, time: fmtHour(currentHour) }); }

function renderLog() {
  document.getElementById('log-feed').innerHTML = [...logEntries].reverse().map(e => {
    const cls = e.type === 'sale' ? 'log-sale' : e.type === 'bad' ? 'log-bad' : 'log-event';
    return `<div class="log-entry"><span class="log-time">${e.time}</span><span class="${cls}">${e.msg}</span></div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function randomTip() {
  const pool = TIPS[selectedGoal] || TIPS.profit;
  document.getElementById('tip-card').innerHTML = `<strong>Tip</strong>${pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)]}`;
}

function updateTimeDisplay() {
  const t = fmtHour(currentHour);
  document.getElementById('time-label').textContent  = t;
  document.getElementById('header-time').textContent = t;
}

function fmtHour(h) {
  if (h === 12) return '12:00 PM';
  if (h === 13) return '1:00 PM';
  return h + ':00 ' + (h < 12 ? 'AM' : 'PM');
}

function setWeatherStrip() {
  const el = document.getElementById('weather-strip-display');
  el.className = 'weather-strip ' + weather.id;
  el.innerHTML = `<span class="weather-icon">${weather.icon}</span><span>${weather.strip}</span>`;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESULTS  (+ save run to history)
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function showResults() {
  const s       = buildStats();
  const goalDef = GOALS[selectedGoal];
  const g       = goalDef.grade(s);

  /* ── save to localStorage ── */
  const now = new Date();
  const dateStr = now.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })
                + ' ' + now.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' });
  saveRun({
    date:           dateStr,
    goal:           selectedGoal,
    goalLabel:      goalDef.label,
    goalShortLabel: goalDef.shortLabel,
    weatherId:      weather.id,
    weatherIcon:    weather.icon,
    weatherLabel:   weather.label,
    profit:         s.profit,
    sellPct:        s.sellPct,
    gradeEmoji:     g.emoji,
    headline:       g.headline,
    verdict:        g.verdict,
    verdictClass:   g.verdictClass,
  });

  /* ── populate results DOM ── */
  document.getElementById('result-grade').textContent    = g.emoji;
  document.getElementById('result-headline').textContent = g.headline;
  document.getElementById('result-summary').textContent  = g.summary;
  document.getElementById('result-goal-verdict').innerHTML = `<span class="goal-verdict ${g.verdictClass}">${g.verdict}</span>`;

  document.getElementById('res-revenue').textContent     = '$' + totalRevenue.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('res-cost').textContent        = '$' + totalCost.toFixed(2);
  const profEl = document.getElementById('res-profit');
  profEl.textContent = (s.profit >= 0 ? '+$' : '-$') + Math.abs(s.profit).toFixed(2);
  profEl.className   = 'rb-value ' + (s.profit >= 0 ? 'profit' : 'loss');
  document.getElementById('res-sold').textContent        = s.soldTotal + ' units';
  document.getElementById('res-sellthrough').textContent = s.sellPct.toFixed(0) + '%';
  document.getElementById('res-best').textContent        = s.best ? s.best.emoji + ' ' + s.best.name : '—';
  if (document.getElementById('res-waste')) {
    document.getElementById('res-waste').textContent = s.maxWaste + ' units';
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.result-box').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('goal-focus'));
  const focusBox = document.getElementById(goalDef.focusBoxId);
  if (focusBox) focusBox.classList.add('goal-focus');

  document.getElementById('breakdown-rows').innerHTML = boothItems.map(item => {
    const rev        = item.sold * item.price;
    const cost       = item.qty  * item.costPer;
    const itemProfit = rev - cost;
    const unsold     = item.qty - item.sold;
    const wasteFlag  = (selectedGoal === 'freshness' && unsold > 3)
      ? `<span style="font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--tomato);margin-left:4px;">⚠ ${unsold} unsold</span>` : '';
    return `
      <div class="brow">
        <div class="bname">${item.emoji} ${item.name}${wasteFlag}</div>
        <div class="bsold">${item.sold} / ${item.qty} sold</div>
        <div class="${itemProfit >= 0 ? 'brevenue' : 'bloss'}">${itemProfit >= 0 ? '+' : '–'}$${Math.abs(itemProfit).toFixed(2)}</div>
      </div>`;
  }).join('');

  showPhase('phase-results');
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESET
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function resetGame() {
  selectedGoal = 'profit';
  selectedIds  = new Set();
  boothItems   = [];
  currentHour  = MARKET_OPEN;
  totalRevenue = 0;
  totalCost    = 0;
  logEntries   = [];
  gameRunning  = false;

  document.getElementById('tick-btn').disabled = false;
  document.getElementById('fast-btn').disabled = false;
  document.getElementById('header-time').textContent = '8:00 AM';

  ['profit','sellthrough','freshness'].forEach(g =>
    document.getElementById('goal-' + g).classList.toggle('selected', g === 'profit')
  );

  weather = WEATHERS[Math.floor(Math.random() * WEATHERS.length)];
  document.getElementById('header-weather').textContent = weather.icon + ' ' + weather.label;

  renderProduceGrid();
  document.getElementById('setup-table-wrap').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('select-prompt').style.display    = 'block';
  showPhase('phase-setup');
}

function showPhase(id) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.phase').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('active');
  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
}

/* ── BOOT ── */
init();
</script>
</body>
</html>

Let me read every pixel of the current file before touching anything.Good — I have the full picture now. Let me plan the changes carefully before writing a single byte:

**Root causes of mobile overflow / cramping:**
1. The `<table>` with 6 columns (emoji, name, qty input, price input, suggested, remove) — tables don't reflow and will push past 390px
2. `header` has `padding: 1.1rem 2rem` — too wide on mobile, and the header-meta row (time + weather badge + history button) can overflow
3. `produce-grid` uses `minmax(180px, 1fr)` — forces 2 columns at ~390px which is fine, but verify
4. `goal-options` already collapses to 1 column via media query
5. `market-layout` already collapses — but the stats panel is full-width underneath which is fine
6. `results-grid` `minmax(160px, 1fr)` → 2 per row at 390px, fine
7. `history-summary` `minmax(130px, 1fr)` → 2 per row, fine
8. `hist-card` 3-column grid with `min-width: 110px` booth items — those are in market phase not history, OK

**The fix strategy:**
- Replace the `<table>` entirely. On mobile: each selected item becomes a compact stacked card (emoji + name + remove row, then two pill-style stepper controls for qty and price side by side). On desktop (≥640px): restore the original tidy table layout via CSS grid inside the same elements — same data, different presentation, no JS branching.
- Tighten the header padding on mobile, collapse the weather badge text to icon-only, make header-meta `gap` smaller
- Add `overflow-x: hidden` to `body` and `html` as a safety net
- Set `produce-grid` to `minmax(160px, 1fr)` so it fits 2 columns at 390px with room to breathe
- Ensure all fixed widths in the lineup section (`price-input: 80px`, `qty-input: 60px`) only apply at ≥640px; on mobile the inputs fill their containerAll checks pass. Zero external URLs, steppers there, overflow guard in place, both lineup views wired up, localStorage intact.Here's what changed and why each decision was made:

**Overflow guard.** `html, body { overflow-x: hidden; max-width: 100% }` on mobile, relaxed back to `overflow-x: auto` at ≥600px. Every fixed-width element in the old file was also audited — inputs, the header, the produce grid minimum — so nothing pushes past the viewport edge.

**Setup lineup: two views, one source of truth.** The `<table>` is gone from mobile entirely. Below 600px you get a stacked card per item with a proper `[ − ][ value ][ + ]` stepper for both quantity and price — 36px tall, thumb-friendly, touch-action optimized so iOS doesn't zoom on double-tap. Above 600px the old compact table reappears via `display: none / block` CSS toggling. Both views render from the same `updateSetupTable()` call and stay in sync through `syncMirror()`, which keeps matching inputs identical whenever either side changes. `openBooth()` prefers the mobile input and falls back to the desktop one, so the correct values always flow into the sim regardless of which layout is visible.

**Header.** Padding trimmed to `0.85rem 1rem` on mobile. Weather badge shows icon only below 600px (`.wb-text { display: none }`) — the icon alone is enough context and saves ~80px of horizontal space. The time label row also hides below 600px; only the clock value stays. Both elements are restored at ≥600px.

**Goal picker.** Switches from a 3-column grid to a single-column flex layout on mobile, with each card rendered horizontally (icon left, text right) so it reads clearly at narrow width without shrinking text to illegibility.

**Produce grid.** `minmax` dropped from 180px to 155px so two columns fit cleanly at 390px with 1rem padding on each side (390 − 32 = 358px ÷ 2 = 179px, which clears 155px with the gap).

**Everything else** — results grid, history summary, history cards — already used `auto-fit / minmax` patterns that reflow naturally, so those required only minor size adjustments for consistency.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>The Market Booth</title>
<style>

  :root {

     HEADER

  .btn-history-header {

    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22);

  /* ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  .section-title {

  /* ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  .lineup-wrap {

  .btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
  .btn-primary  { background: var(--sage-dark); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(78,110,82,0.3); }

  .btn-secondary { background: var(--parchment); color: var(--bark-dark); border: 1.5px solid var(--border); }
  .btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--gold-light); }
  .btn-danger { background: #fde8e6; color: var(--tomato); border: 1.5px solid rgba(192,57,43,0.25); }

  /* Full-width CTA on mobile */

  /* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
     MARKET DAY

  .market-layout { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.25rem; }

  .goal-progress-wrap { margin-top: 0.75rem; padding-top: 0.75rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); }

  .goal-track { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 99px; height: 6px; overflow: hidden; }
  .goal-fill  { height: 100%; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--gold); transition: width 0.7s ease; }
  .tip-card { background: var(--gold-light); border: 1.5px solid var(--gold); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #6b4a00; line-height: 1.5; }
  .tip-card strong { display: block; font-size: 0.73rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; color: #7a5500; }

  /* Weather strip */
  .weather-strip { border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.55rem 0.85rem; font-size: 0.8rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; }
  .weather-strip.sunny  { background: #fffaed; border: 1px solid #e0c860; color: #7a5a00; }
  .weather-strip.cloudy { background: #f0f4f8; border: 1px solid #b0bec5; color: #455a64; }
  .weather-strip.rainy  { background: #e8f4fb; border: 1px solid #90caf9; color: #1a5276; }
  .weather-icon { font-size: 1.1rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

  /* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
     RESULTS
  ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
  .results-banner { text-align: center; padding: 1.5rem 1rem; }
  .results-banner .grade { font-size: 3.5rem; line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
  .results-banner h2 { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--bark-dark); margin-bottom: 0.35rem; }
  .results-banner p  { font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--muted); max-width: 400px; margin: 0 auto; line-height: 1.55; }
  .goal-verdict { display: inline-block; margin-top: 0.65rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; }
  .goal-verdict.met     { background: #d4f0dc; color: #1a5c31; }
  .goal-verdict.missed  { background: #fde8e6; color: #7a1e1e; }
  .goal-verdict.partial { background: var(--gold-light); color: #7a5500; }
  .results-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr)); gap: 0.75rem; margin: 1.5rem 0; }
  .result-box { background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; text-align: center; }
  .result-box .rb-label { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; }
  .result-box .rb-value { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--bark-dark); }
  .result-box .rb-value.profit { color: var(--sage-dark); }
  .result-box .rb-value.loss   { color: var(--tomato); }
  .result-box.goal-focus { border-color: var(--sage-dark); background: #f3faf4; }
  .result-box.goal-focus .rb-label::after { content: ' ★'; color: var(--sage-dark); }
  .breakdown-table { background: var(--parchment); border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.9rem 1rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
  .breakdown-table h3 { font-family: var(--serif); color: var(--bark-dark); font-size: 0.95rem; margin-bottom: 0.65rem; }
  .brow { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 0.82rem; padding: 0.38rem 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border); color: var(--ink-soft); gap: 0.4rem; }
  .brow:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .brow .bname    { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-size: 0.8rem; }
  .brow .bsold    { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.75rem; white-space: nowrap; }
  .brow .brevenue { font-weight: 700; color: var(--sage-dark); white-space: nowrap; text-align: right; }
  .brow .bloss    { font-weight: 700; color: var(--tomato);    white-space: nowrap; text-align: right; }

  /* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
     HISTORY
  ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
  .history-header-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .history-empty { text-align: center; padding: 3rem 1rem; color: var(--muted); }
  .history-empty .empty-icon { font-size: 2.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.65rem; }
  .history-empty p { font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.6; }
  .history-summary { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(120px, 1fr)); gap: 0.6rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
  .hs-box { background: var(--parchment); border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem; text-align: center; }
  .hs-box .hs-label { font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
  .hs-box .hs-value { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--bark-dark); }
  .hs-box .hs-value.pos { color: var(--sage-dark); }
  .hs-box .hs-value.neg { color: var(--tomato); }

  .hist-card {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 2.2rem 1fr auto;
    gap: 0 0.75rem;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .hist-card:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .hist-grade { font-size: 1.6rem; text-align: center; }
  .hist-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
  .hist-run-num { font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--muted); }
  .hist-date    { font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--muted); margin-left: auto; white-space: nowrap; }
  .hist-chips   { display: flex; gap: 0.35rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .hist-chip {
    display: inline-block; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700;
    padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--ink-soft); background: var(--cream); white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .hist-chip.goal-chip { background: var(--parchment); color: var(--bark-dark); }
  .hist-chip.weather-chip        { background: #fffaed; color: #7a5a00; border-color: #e0c860; }
  .hist-chip.weather-chip.rainy  { background: #e8f4fb; color: #1a5276; border-color: #90caf9; }
  .hist-chip.weather-chip.cloudy { background: #f0f4f8; color: #455a64; border-color: #b0bec5; }
  .hist-nums { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
  .hist-profit { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--sage-dark); }
  .hist-profit.neg { color: var(--tomato); }
  .hist-sell { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; }
  .hist-verdict { font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 3px; }
  .hist-verdict.met     { color: #1a5c31; }
  .hist-verdict.missed  { color: #7a1e1e; }
  .hist-verdict.partial { color: #7a5500; }
  .hist-card.newest { border-color: var(--sage-dark); background: #f8fdf9; }
  .hist-card.newest::before {
    content: 'Latest';
    display: block; grid-column: 1 / -1;
    font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.07em; color: var(--sage-dark); margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
  }

  /* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
     DESKTOP BREAKPOINT (≥ 600px)
     Restore wider layouts and the table for lineup
  ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
  @media (min-width: 600px) {
    html, body { overflow-x: auto; } /* allow normal scroll on desktop */
    header { padding: 1rem 1.75rem; }
    header h1 { font-size: 1.4rem; }
    .time-display .t-label { display: block; }
    .time-display .clock   { font-size: 1.05rem; }
    .weather-badge .wb-text { display: inline; margin-left: 0.2rem; }
    .phase { padding: 1.75rem 1.5rem; }
    .section-title { font-size: 1.3rem; }

    /* Goal picker: 3 columns, vertical card layout */
    .goal-options { flex-direction: row; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 0.7rem; }
    .goal-card { flex-direction: column; gap: 0; }
    .goal-icon { font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
    .goal-name { font-size: 0.9rem; }
    .goal-desc { font-size: 0.74rem; }

    /* Produce grid: a bit wider minimum */
    .produce-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(175px, 1fr)); gap: 0.85rem; }
    .produce-emoji { font-size: 1.9rem; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; }
    .produce-name  { font-size: 0.95rem; }
    .produce-hint  { font-size: 0.75rem; }
    .produce-cost  { font-size: 0.8rem; }

    /* Lineup: replace the mobile card stack with a compact table.
       The .lineup-stack becomes invisible; .lineup-table-wrap takes over. */
    .lineup-stack        { display: none; }
    .lineup-table-wrap   { display: block; }

    /* Market day: side-by-side */
    .market-layout { flex-direction: row; align-items: start; }
    .market-main   { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
    .stats-panel   { width: 270px; flex-shrink: 0; position: sticky; top: 68px; }

    /* Buttons: normal inline width */
    .btn-full { display: inline-block; width: auto; }
  }

  /* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
     DESKTOP TABLE for lineup (hidden on mobile,
     shown via the media query above)
  ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
  .lineup-table-wrap { display: none; } /* hidden by default; shown at ≥600px */
  table.price-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.88rem; }
  table.price-table th {
    text-align: left; padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
    color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem;
    text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  table.price-table td { padding: 0.4rem 0.5rem; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border); color: var(--ink-soft); vertical-align: middle; }
  table.price-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
  .price-input { width: 80px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.88rem; font-family: var(--sans); background: #fff; color: var(--ink); }
  .price-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--bark); }
  .qty-input   { width: 60px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.88rem; font-family: var(--sans); background: #fff; color: var(--ink); }
  .qty-input:focus   { outline: none; border-color: var(--bark); }
  .remove-btn { background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; color: #bbb; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.1rem 0.3rem; border-radius: 4px; transition: color 0.15s; }
  .remove-btn:hover { color: var(--tomato); }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <h1>🌿 The Market Booth</h1>
  <div class="header-meta">
    <div class="time-display">
      <span class="t-label" id="header-date">Saturday</span>
      <span class="clock" id="header-time">8:00 AM</span>
    </div>
    <div class="weather-badge" id="header-weather">
      <span id="hdr-weather-icon">☀️</span><span class="wb-text" id="hdr-weather-text"> Sunny</span>
    </div>
    <button class="btn-history-header" onclick="showPhase('phase-history'); renderHistory();">
      <span>History</span><span class="hist-count" id="hist-count" style="display:none;">0</span>
    </button>
  </div>
</header>


<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════
     PHASE 1: SETUP
═══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<section class="phase active" id="phase-setup">

  <h2 class="section-title">What's your goal today?</h2>
  <p class="section-sub">Pick a focus for the day. Your end-of-market grade will be judged against it.</p>

  <div class="goal-picker">
    <div class="goal-picker-label">Booth goal</div>
    <div class="goal-options">
      <div class="goal-card selected" id="goal-profit" onclick="selectGoal('profit')">
        <div class="goal-icon">💰</div>
        <div class="goal-text">
          <div class="goal-name">Turn a Profit</div>
          <div class="goal-desc">Maximize net revenue over wholesale cost. Margin is everything.</div>
          <div class="goal-target">Target: profit > $0</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="goal-card" id="goal-sellthrough" onclick="selectGoal('sellthrough')">
        <div class="goal-icon">🧺</div>
        <div class="goal-text">
          <div class="goal-name">Empty the Booth</div>
          <div class="goal-desc">Move as much inventory as possible. Don't haul anything home.</div>
          <div class="goal-target">Target: sell-through ≥ 85%</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="goal-card" id="goal-freshness" onclick="selectGoal('freshness')">
        <div class="goal-icon">🌱</div>
        <div class="goal-text">
          <div class="goal-name">No Waste</div>
          <div class="goal-desc">Keep unsold units low — this produce won't last another week.</div>
          <div class="goal-target">Target: waste ≤ 3 units / item</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <hr class="divider">

  <h2 class="section-title">Pick your produce</h2>
  <p class="section-sub">Choose what to bring to market. Each item has a wholesale cost — you pay it upfront, then try to sell before 1 PM. Pick at least 2.</p>

  <div class="produce-grid" id="produce-grid"></div>

  <hr class="divider">

  <div id="setup-table-wrap" style="display:none;">

    <!-- ── MOBILE: stacked item cards ── -->
    <div class="lineup-wrap">
      <h3>Your lineup — set prices & quantities</h3>
      <div class="lineup-stack" id="lineup-stack"></div>

      <!-- ── DESKTOP: compact table (shown via CSS at ≥600px) ── -->
      <div class="lineup-table-wrap">
        <table class="price-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th></th><th>Item</th><th>Qty</th><th>Price / unit</th><th>Suggested</th><th></th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody id="price-tbody"></tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="cost-bar">
      <span>Total wholesale cost</span>
      <span class="val" id="total-cost-display">$0.00</span>
    </div>

    <div class="btn-row">
      <button class="btn btn-primary btn-full" onclick="openBooth()">Open the booth →</button>
      <span id="setup-error" style="font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--tomato);"></span>
    </div>

  </div>

  <div id="select-prompt" style="font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:0.4rem;">
    Select items above to build your lineup.
  </div>

</section>


<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════
     PHASE 2: MARKET DAY
═══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<section class="phase" id="phase-market">

  <div id="weather-strip-display" class="weather-strip sunny">
    <span class="weather-icon">☀️</span>
    <span>Beautiful day — steady foot traffic expected.</span>
  </div>

  <div class="market-layout">
    <!-- Main column -->
    <div class="market-main">
      <div style="margin-bottom:0.5rem;" id="market-goal-badge"></div>

      <div class="booth-visual">
        <div class="booth-banner">🪴 Your Booth · Green Hill Farm</div>
        <div class="booth-items" id="booth-items-display"></div>
      </div>

      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:0.4rem;">
        <span style="font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--muted);">Market day progress</span>
        <span style="font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--bark-dark);" id="time-label">8:00 AM</span>
      </div>
      <div class="progress-track"><div class="progress-fill" id="progress-fill" style="width:0%"></div></div>

      <div style="display:flex;gap:0.5rem;margin:0.85rem 0 0.6rem;">
        <button class="btn btn-primary" id="tick-btn" onclick="doTick()" style="flex:1;">⏱ Next hour</button>
        <button class="btn btn-secondary" id="fast-btn" onclick="fastForward()">⏩ Fast-forward</button>
      </div>

      <div style="font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--bark-dark);margin-bottom:0.4rem;">Market log</div>
      <div class="log-feed" id="log-feed"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Stats sidebar -->
    <div class="stats-panel">
      <div class="stats-card">
        <h3>Live financials</h3>
        <div class="stat-row"><span class="label">Revenue so far</span><span class="value green" id="live-revenue">$0.00</span></div>
        <div class="stat-row"><span class="label">Cost paid</span><span class="value" id="live-cost">$0.00</span></div>
        <div class="stat-row"><span class="label">Net profit</span><span class="value" id="live-profit">–$0.00</span></div>
        <div class="stat-row"><span class="label">Units sold</span><span class="value" id="live-sold">0</span></div>
        <div class="stat-row"><span class="label">Units remaining</span><span class="value" id="live-remain">0</span></div>
        <div class="goal-progress-wrap">
          <div class="goal-progress-label">
            <span id="goal-prog-label">Goal progress</span>
            <span id="goal-prog-pct">0%</span>
          </div>
          <div class="goal-track"><div class="goal-fill" id="goal-fill" style="width:0%"></div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="tip-card" id="tip-card">
        <strong>Tip</strong>
        The market opens at 8 AM. Morning is prime time — don't wait too long to see results.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>


<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════
     PHASE 3: RESULTS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<section class="phase" id="phase-results">

  <div class="results-banner">
    <div class="grade" id="result-grade">🌻</div>
    <h2 id="result-headline">Market's closed!</h2>
    <div id="result-goal-verdict"></div>
    <p id="result-summary" style="margin-top:0.55rem;">Here's how your day went at the booth.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="results-grid" id="results-grid">
    <div class="result-box" id="rbox-revenue"><div class="rb-label">Revenue</div><div class="rb-value" id="res-revenue">—</div></div>
    <div class="result-box" id="rbox-cost"><div class="rb-label">Wholesale cost</div><div class="rb-value" id="res-cost">—</div></div>
    <div class="result-box" id="rbox-profit"><div class="rb-label">Net profit / loss</div><div class="rb-value" id="res-profit">—</div></div>
    <div class="result-box" id="rbox-sold"><div class="rb-label">Units sold</div><div class="rb-value" id="res-sold">—</div></div>
    <div class="result-box" id="rbox-sellthrough"><div class="rb-label">Sell-through rate</div><div class="rb-value" id="res-sellthrough">—</div></div>
    <div class="result-box" id="rbox-best"><div class="rb-label">Best seller</div><div class="rb-value" id="res-best">—</div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="breakdown-table">
    <h3>Item-by-item breakdown</h3>
    <div id="breakdown-rows"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="btn-row">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="resetGame()">🌿 New day, new booth</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="showPhase('phase-history'); renderHistory();">View history</button>
  </div>

</section>


<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════
     PHASE 4: HISTORY
═══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<section class="phase" id="phase-history">

  <div class="history-header-row">
    <div>
      <h2 class="section-title">Market day history</h2>
      <p class="section-sub" style="margin-bottom:0;">All completed runs, saved locally in this browser.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="btn-row" style="flex-shrink:0;margin-top:0.25rem;">
      <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="showPhase('phase-setup')">← Setup</button>
      <button class="btn btn-danger"    onclick="confirmClearHistory()">Clear</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <hr class="divider">
  <div id="history-summary-wrap"></div>
  <div id="history-list"></div>

</section>


<script>
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   DATA
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const PRODUCE = [
  { id:'tomato',   emoji:'🍅', name:'Heirloom Tomatoes', hint:'Always popular. Goes fast.',       costPer:0.45, suggestPrice:1.50, unit:'lb',    defaultQty:30 },
  { id:'corn',     emoji:'🌽', name:'Sweet Corn',         hint:'Summer staple. Price it right.',  costPer:0.30, suggestPrice:0.90, unit:'ear',   defaultQty:40 },
  { id:'zucchini', emoji:'🥒', name:'Zucchini',           hint:"Slow mover. Don't overbuy.",      costPer:0.25, suggestPrice:0.80, unit:'each',  defaultQty:20 },
  { id:'peach',    emoji:'🍑', name:'Peaches',            hint:'Premium item. Sell by aroma.',    costPer:0.65, suggestPrice:2.25, unit:'each',  defaultQty:25 },
  { id:'herb',     emoji:'🌿', name:'Mixed Herb Bundles', hint:'Low cost, high margin.',           costPer:0.40, suggestPrice:3.00, unit:'bunch', defaultQty:15 },
  { id:'pepper',   emoji:'🫑', name:'Bell Peppers',       hint:'Colorful, sells well.',            costPer:0.35, suggestPrice:1.20, unit:'each',  defaultQty:30 },
  { id:'garlic',   emoji:'🧄', name:'Garlic Heads',       hint:'Niche but loyal buyers.',          costPer:0.20, suggestPrice:1.50, unit:'head',  defaultQty:20 },
  { id:'berry',    emoji:'🍓', name:'Mixed Berries',      hint:'High value, short shelf life.',    costPer:0.90, suggestPrice:4.00, unit:'pint',  defaultQty:18 },
  { id:'squash',   emoji:'🎃', name:'Butternut Squash',   hint:'Heavy, low sell-through risk.',    costPer:0.55, suggestPrice:2.00, unit:'each',  defaultQty:15 },
  { id:'lettuce',  emoji:'🥬', name:'Lettuce Heads',      hint:'Morning rush item.',               costPer:0.30, suggestPrice:1.80, unit:'head',  defaultQty:20 },
];

const WEATHERS = [
  { id:'sunny',  icon:'☀️',  label:'Sunny & warm',  strip:'Beautiful sunny day — steady foot traffic all morning.', trafficMod:1.20, demandMod:1.10 },
  { id:'cloudy', icon:'⛅',  label:'Partly cloudy', strip:'Mild and cloudy — normal turnout, average traffic.',     trafficMod:1.00, demandMod:1.00 },
  { id:'rainy',  icon:'🌧️', label:'Rainy',          strip:'Light rain today — expect lighter crowds than usual.',   trafficMod:0.65, demandMod:0.85 },
];

const GOALS = {
  profit: {
    label:'💰 Turn a Profit', shortLabel:'💰 Profit',
    focusBoxId:'rbox-profit', progressLabel:'Profit target',
    progressOf(s) { return Math.min(Math.max((s.profit + 20) / 50, 0), 1); },
    grade(s) {
      const p = s.profit;
      if (p >= 50)  return { emoji:'🌟', headline:'Incredible margins!',   verdictClass:'met',     verdict:'Goal met — handsome profit',      summary:`You turned $${p.toFixed(2)} net profit. Pricing strategy paid off.` };
      if (p >= 20)  return { emoji:'🌻', headline:'Profitable day!',       verdictClass:'met',     verdict:'Goal met — solidly in the black', summary:`$${p.toFixed(2)} net profit. The booth is working.` };
      if (p >= 1)   return { emoji:'🌾', headline:'Just scraped by.',      verdictClass:'partial', verdict:'Barely profitable',               summary:`Only $${p.toFixed(2)} profit. A closer run than it needed to be.` };
      if (p >= -10) return { emoji:'☁️', headline:'Break-even territory.', verdictClass:'partial', verdict:'Goal missed — near break-even',   summary:`$${Math.abs(p).toFixed(2)} short of profit. Tighten quantities next time.` };
      return         { emoji:'🥀', headline:'Tough day at the booth.',     verdictClass:'missed',  verdict:'Goal missed — took a loss',       summary:`Lost $${Math.abs(p).toFixed(2)} today. Revisit pricing or reduce overstock.` };
    },
  },
  sellthrough: {
    label:'🧺 Empty the Booth', shortLabel:'🧺 Sell-through',
    focusBoxId:'rbox-sellthrough', progressLabel:'Sell-through target (85%)',
    progressOf(s) { return Math.min(s.sellPct / 85, 1); },
    grade(s) {
      const pct = s.sellPct;
      if (pct >= 95) return { emoji:'🌟', headline:'Wiped clean!',         verdictClass:'met',     verdict:'Goal crushed — near-total sell-through', summary:`${pct.toFixed(0)}% sold. Virtually nothing left. Masterful.` };
      if (pct >= 85) return { emoji:'🌻', headline:'Almost nothing left!', verdictClass:'met',     verdict:'Goal met — 85%+ sold',                   summary:`${pct.toFixed(0)}% sell-through. The booth went home light.` };
      if (pct >= 70) return { emoji:'🌾', headline:'Pretty good haul.',    verdictClass:'partial', verdict:'Close — a few units lingered',            summary:`${pct.toFixed(0)}% sold. You'll be lugging some produce home, but not much.` };
      if (pct >= 50) return { emoji:'☁️', headline:'Half left behind.',    verdictClass:'missed',  verdict:'Goal missed — too much unsold',           summary:`Only ${pct.toFixed(0)}% sold through. Consider lower prices or smaller quantities.` };
      return          { emoji:'🥀', headline:'Booth barely moved.',        verdictClass:'missed',  verdict:'Goal missed — most stock unsold',         summary:`${pct.toFixed(0)}% sell-through. Pricing too high or quantities too ambitious.` };
    },
  },
  freshness: {
    label:'🌱 No Waste', shortLabel:'🌱 No Waste',
    focusBoxId:'rbox-waste', progressLabel:'Items within waste target',
    progressOf(s) {
      const within = s.items.filter(i => (i.qty - i.sold) <= 3).length;
      return s.items.length > 0 ? within / s.items.length : 0;
    },
    grade(s) {
      const wastedItems = s.items.filter(i => (i.qty - i.sold) > 3);
      const totalWaste  = s.items.reduce((a, i) => a + Math.max(0, i.qty - i.sold), 0);
      if (wastedItems.length === 0) return { emoji:'🌟', headline:'Zero waste!',           verdictClass:'met',     verdict:'Goal met — nothing wasted',          summary:`Every item came in at 3 unsold units or fewer. Pristine day.` };
      if (wastedItems.length === 1) return { emoji:'🌻', headline:'Nearly waste-free.',    verdictClass:'met',     verdict:'Goal met — one item over threshold',  summary:`Just one item went over the waste limit. ${totalWaste} units total unsold.` };
      if (wastedItems.length === 2) return { emoji:'🌾', headline:'A little left behind.', verdictClass:'partial', verdict:'Partial — 2 items over threshold',    summary:`${wastedItems.length} items had more than 3 unsold. ${totalWaste} units went home.` };
      return                         { emoji:'🥀', headline:'Too much unsold.',            verdictClass:'missed',  verdict:'Goal missed — significant waste',     summary:`${wastedItems.length} items exceeded the waste threshold. Overbought or underpriced.` };
    },
  },
};

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
