<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>The Market Booth</title>
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  html, body { overflow-x: hidden; max-width: 100%; }

  :root {
    --serif: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
    --sans:  'Gill Sans', 'Gill Sans MT', Calibri, 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif;
    --mono:  'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
    --cream: #FAF6EE;
    --parchment: #F0E8D5;
    --bark: #8B6340;
    --bark-dark: #5C3E25;
    --sage: #7A9E7E;
    --sage-dark: #4E6E52;
    --tomato: #C0392B;
    --gold: #D4A017;
    --gold-light: #F5E6B2;
    --ink: #2C1F0E;
    --ink-soft: #5A4030;
    --muted: #9A7E65;
    --border: rgba(139,99,64,0.25);
    --shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(92,62,37,0.10);
  }

  body { font-family: var(--sans); background: var(--cream); color: var(--ink); min-height: 100vh; }

  /* ── HEADER ── */
  header {
    background: var(--bark-dark);
    /* Hard-cap to viewport width — this is the overflow containment boundary */
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100vw;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.5rem; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100;
    /* box-sizing already border-box globally, but be explicit */
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
  header h1 {
    font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--gold-light);
    letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1.2; font-style: italic;
    white-space: nowrap;
    /* Allow h1 to yield width before anything else clips */
    flex: 0 1 auto;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }
  /* Right-side cluster: time + weather + history — shrinks as a unit */
  .header-meta {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;
    flex: 0 0 auto;   /* fixed size; individual children compress */
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .time-display {
    font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--parchment);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end;
    line-height: 1.25; flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .time-display .t-label { display: none; }
  .time-display .clock { font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; }
  .weather-badge {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--gold-light);
    white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .weather-badge .wb-text { display: none; }
  /* History button: flex container so label can clip while badge stays */
  .btn-history-header {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.13); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22);
    border-radius: 20px; padding: 0.25rem 0.6rem;
    font-size: 0.78rem; font-family: var(--sans); font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--gold-light); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s;
    /* Allow button to shrink when space is tight */
    flex-shrink: 1; min-width: 0;
    /* Inner layout: text + badge side by side */
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .btn-history-header:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.22); }
  /* "History" text — clips with ellipsis when squeezed */
  .btn-history-header .hdr-label {
    overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;
    flex-shrink: 1; min-width: 0;
  }
  /* Count badge — never hidden, never shrinks */
  .hist-count {
    display: inline-block; background: var(--gold); color: var(--bark-dark);
    border-radius: 99px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700;
    padding: 0 5px; margin-left: 3px; min-width: 16px; text-align: center;
    flex-shrink: 0; white-space: nowrap;
  }

  /* ── PHASES ── */
  .phase { display: none; max-width: 860px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 1.25rem 1rem; }
  .phase.active { display: block; }

  /* ── TYPOGRAPHY ── */
  .section-title { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 1.2rem; color: var(--bark-dark); margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
  .section-sub { font-size: 0.83rem; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.5; }
  .divider { border: none; border-top: 1.5px dashed var(--border); margin: 1.5rem 0; }

  /* ── GOAL PICKER ── */
  .goal-picker { margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
  .goal-picker-label { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 0.55rem; }
  .goal-options { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.55rem; }
  .goal-card { border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; cursor: pointer; background: #fff; transition: border-color 0.15s; user-select: none; position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.75rem; }
  .goal-card:hover { border-color: var(--bark); }
  .goal-card.selected { border-color: var(--sage-dark); background: #f3faf4; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(78,110,82,0.20); }
  .goal-card.selected::after { content: '✓'; position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 10px; font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--sage-dark); font-weight: 700; }
  .goal-icon { font-size: 1.4rem; flex-shrink: 0; padding-top: 0.1rem; }
  .goal-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .goal-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 0.15rem; }
  .goal-desc { font-size: 0.73rem; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.4; }
  .goal-target { margin-top: 0.3rem; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--bark); font-family: var(--mono); }
  .goal-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; background: var(--parchment); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; padding: 0.25rem 0.7rem; font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--bark-dark); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }

  /* ── PRESET STRIP ── */
  .preset-strip { margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
  .preset-strip-label { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 0.55rem; }
  .preset-options { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.45rem; }
  .preset-btn {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem;
    background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9px;
    padding: 0.6rem 0.85rem; cursor: pointer; text-align: left;
    transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
    font-family: var(--sans);
    touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  .preset-btn:hover { border-color: var(--bark); background: var(--parchment); }
  .preset-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); }
  .preset-icon { font-size: 1.25rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .preset-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .preset-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--ink); }
  .preset-desc { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 0.1rem; line-height: 1.35; }
  .preset-tag { font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; background: var(--gold-light); color: #7a5500; border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 5px; white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0; }

  /* ── PRODUCE GRID ── */
  .produce-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(155px, 1fr)); gap: 0.65rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
  .produce-card { background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; user-select: none; position: relative; }
  .produce-card:hover { border-color: var(--bark); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  .produce-card.selected { border-color: var(--sage-dark); background: #f3faf4; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(78,110,82,0.20); }
  .produce-card.selected::after { content: '✓'; position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 9px; font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--sage-dark); font-weight: 700; }
  .produce-emoji { font-size: 1.6rem; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; display: block; }
  .produce-name  { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--ink); line-height: 1.3; }
  .produce-hint  { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 0.15rem; line-height: 1.35; }
  .produce-cost  { margin-top: 0.4rem; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--bark); font-weight: 700; }

  /* ── LINEUP (MOBILE STACK) ── */
  .lineup-wrap { background: var(--parchment); border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.9rem 1rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
  .lineup-wrap h3 { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--bark-dark); margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
  .lineup-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6rem; }
  .lineup-item { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem; }
  .li-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
  .li-emoji { font-size: 1.2rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .li-name  { flex: 1; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--ink); min-width: 0; }
  .li-cost-hint { font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 1px; }
  .li-remove { background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; color: #c5b09a; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.15rem 0.25rem; border-radius: 4px; transition: color 0.15s; flex-shrink: 0; line-height: 1; }
  .li-remove:hover { color: var(--tomato); }
  .li-controls { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0.5rem; }
  .li-control-label { font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 0.2rem; }
  .stepper { display: flex; align-items: center; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 7px; overflow: hidden; background: #fff; height: 36px; }
  .stepper-btn { background: var(--parchment); border: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--bark-dark); width: 34px; flex-shrink: 0; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background 0.12s; touch-action: manipulation; user-select: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  .stepper-btn:active { background: var(--gold-light); }
  .stepper-val { flex: 1; text-align: center; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); border: none; background: transparent; padding: 0; min-width: 0; cursor: text; font-family: var(--sans); }
  .stepper-val:focus { outline: none; background: #fffef8; }
  .li-fair-hint { font-size: 0.68rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 3px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; }
  .suggestion-tag { display: inline-block; font-size: 0.65rem; background: var(--gold-light); color: #7a5a00; border-radius: 3px; padding: 1px 4px; }

  /* ── COST BAR ── */
  .cost-bar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: var(--bark-dark); color: var(--gold-light); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; font-size: 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
  .cost-bar .val { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; }

  /* ── BUTTONS ── */
  .btn { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 0.65rem 1.4rem; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.1s, box-shadow 0.1s; touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  .btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
  .btn-primary   { background: var(--sage-dark); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(78,110,82,0.3); }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--sage); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(78,110,82,0.4); }
  .btn-secondary { background: var(--parchment); color: var(--bark-dark); border: 1.5px solid var(--border); }
  .btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--gold-light); }
  .btn-danger    { background: #fde8e6; color: var(--tomato); border: 1.5px solid rgba(192,57,43,0.25); }
  .btn-danger:hover { background: #facbc7; }
  .btn-copy { background: var(--parchment); color: var(--bark-dark); border: 1.5px solid var(--border); font-size: 0.82rem; padding: 0.45rem 1rem; }
  .btn-copy.copied { background: #d4f0dc; color: #1a5c31; border-color: #8ecfa8; }
  .btn-full { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: center; }
  .btn-row  { display: flex; gap: 0.65rem; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }

  /* ── MARKET DAY ── */
  .market-layout { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.25rem; }
  .booth-visual  { background: var(--parchment); border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  .booth-banner  { text-align: center; font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--bark-dark); font-style: italic; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; padding-bottom: 0.65rem; border-bottom: 1.5px dashed var(--border); }
  .booth-items   { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; }
  .booth-item    { background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.45rem 0.65rem; font-size: 0.8rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; min-width: 0; transition: background 0.3s; }
  .booth-item.selling-out { background: #fffbe8; border-color: var(--gold); }
  .booth-item.sold-out    { background: #f5f5f5; opacity: 0.55; }
  .booth-item .item-emoji { font-size: 1.1rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .booth-item .item-info  { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .booth-item .item-name  { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.77rem; color: var(--ink); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .booth-item .item-price { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--sage-dark); }
  .booth-item .item-stock { font-size: 0.68rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 1px; }
  .progress-track { background: var(--border); border-radius: 99px; height: 8px; margin: 0.5rem 0; overflow: hidden; }
  .progress-fill  { height: 100%; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--sage-dark); transition: width 0.8s ease; }
  .log-feed { background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem; height: 220px; overflow-y: auto; font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.5; }
  .log-feed::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }
  .log-feed::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border); border-radius: 99px; }
  .log-entry { padding: 0.25rem 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(139,99,64,0.12); color: var(--ink-soft); display: flex; gap: 0.45rem; animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease; }
  .log-entry:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .log-time  { color: var(--muted); min-width: 40px; font-size: 0.73rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .log-sale  { color: var(--sage-dark); font-weight: 700; }
  .log-event { color: var(--bark); }
  .log-bad   { color: var(--tomato); }
  @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(3px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
  .stats-card { background: var(--bark-dark); border-radius: 12px; padding: 1rem 1.1rem; color: var(--parchment); margin-bottom: 0.9rem; }
  .stats-card h3 { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--gold-light); margin-bottom: 0.75rem; font-style: italic; }
  .stat-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.83rem; padding: 0.28rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
  .stat-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .stat-row .label { color: var(--muted); }
  .stat-row .value { font-weight: 700; color: #fff; }
  .stat-row .value.green { color: #7fd9a0; }
  .stat-row .value.red   { color: #f9a09a; }
  .goal-progress-wrap { margin-top: 0.75rem; padding-top: 0.75rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); }
  .goal-progress-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.73rem; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 0.28rem; }
  .goal-progress-label span:last-child { color: var(--gold-light); font-weight: 700; }
  .goal-track { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 99px; height: 6px; overflow: hidden; }
  .goal-fill  { height: 100%; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--gold); transition: width 0.7s ease; }
  .tip-card { background: var(--gold-light); border: 1.5px solid var(--gold); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #6b4a00; line-height: 1.5; }
  .tip-card strong { display: block; font-size: 0.73rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; color: #7a5500; }
  .weather-strip { border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.55rem 0.85rem; font-size: 0.8rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; }
  .weather-strip.sunny  { background: #fffaed; border: 1px solid #e0c860; color: #7a5a00; }
  .weather-strip.cloudy { background: #f0f4f8; border: 1px solid #b0bec5; color: #455a64; }
  .weather-strip.rainy  { background: #e8f4fb; border: 1px solid #90caf9; color: #1a5276; }
  .weather-icon { font-size: 1.1rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

  /* ── RESULTS ── */
  .results-banner { text-align: center; padding: 1.5rem 1rem; }
  .results-banner .grade { font-size: 3.5rem; line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
  .results-banner h2 { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--bark-dark); margin-bottom: 0.35rem; }
  .results-banner p  { font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--muted); max-width: 400px; margin: 0 auto; line-height: 1.55; }
  .goal-verdict { display: inline-block; margin-top: 0.65rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; }
  .goal-verdict.met     { background: #d4f0dc; color: #1a5c31; }
  .goal-verdict.missed  { background: #fde8e6; color: #7a1e1e; }
  .goal-verdict.partial { background: var(--gold-light); color: #7a5500; }
  .results-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr)); gap: 0.75rem; margin: 1.5rem 0; }
  .result-box { background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; text-align: center; }
  .result-box .rb-label { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; }
  .result-box .rb-value { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--bark-dark); }
  .result-box .rb-value.profit { color: var(--sage-dark); }
  .result-box .rb-value.loss   { color: var(--tomato); }
  .result-box.goal-focus { border-color: var(--sage-dark); background: #f3faf4; }
  .result-box.goal-focus .rb-label::after { content: ' ★'; color: var(--sage-dark); }
  .breakdown-table { background: var(--parchment); border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.9rem 1rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
  .breakdown-table h3 { font-family: var(--serif); color: var(--bark-dark); font-size: 0.95rem; margin-bottom: 0.65rem; }
  .brow { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 0.82rem; padding: 0.38rem 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border); color: var(--ink-soft); gap: 0.4rem; }
  .brow:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .brow .bname    { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-size: 0.8rem; }
  .brow .bsold    { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.75rem; white-space: nowrap; }
  .brow .brevenue { font-weight: 700; color: var(--sage-dark); white-space: nowrap; text-align: right; }
  .brow .bloss    { font-weight: 700; color: var(--tomato);    white-space: nowrap; text-align: right; }

  /* ── BOOTH REPORT ── */
  .report-wrap {
    background: var(--parchment);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  }
  .report-header {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 0.65rem; flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .report-header h3 { font-family: var(--serif); color: var(--bark-dark); font-size: 0.95rem; }
  .report-ta {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 180px;
    resize: vertical;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    line-height: 1.55;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    cursor: text;
    white-space: pre;
    overflow-x: auto;
  }
  .report-ta:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--bark); }

  /* ── HISTORY ── */
  .history-header-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .history-empty { text-align: center; padding: 3rem 1rem; color: var(--muted); }
  .history-empty .empty-icon { font-size: 2.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.65rem; }
  .history-empty p { font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.6; }
  .history-summary { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(120px, 1fr)); gap: 0.6rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
  .hs-box { background: var(--parchment); border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem; text-align: center; }
  .hs-box .hs-label { font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
  .hs-box .hs-value { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--bark-dark); }
  .hs-box .hs-value.pos { color: var(--sage-dark); }
  .hs-box .hs-value.neg { color: var(--tomato); }
  .hist-card { background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; margin-bottom: 0.65rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.2rem 1fr auto; gap: 0 0.75rem; align-items: center; }
  .hist-card:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .hist-grade { font-size: 1.6rem; text-align: center; }
  .hist-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
  .hist-run-num { font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--muted); }
  .hist-date    { font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--muted); margin-left: auto; white-space: nowrap; }
  .hist-chips   { display: flex; gap: 0.35rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .hist-chip { display: inline-block; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--ink-soft); background: var(--cream); white-space: nowrap; }
  .hist-chip.goal-chip { background: var(--parchment); color: var(--bark-dark); }
  .hist-chip.weather-chip        { background: #fffaed; color: #7a5a00; border-color: #e0c860; }
  .hist-chip.weather-chip.rainy  { background: #e8f4fb; color: #1a5276; border-color: #90caf9; }
  .hist-chip.weather-chip.cloudy { background: #f0f4f8; color: #455a64; border-color: #b0bec5; }
  .hist-nums { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
  .hist-profit { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--sage-dark); }
  .hist-profit.neg { color: var(--tomato); }
  .hist-sell { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; }
  .hist-verdict { font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 3px; }
  .hist-verdict.met     { color: #1a5c31; }
  .hist-verdict.missed  { color: #7a1e1e; }
  .hist-verdict.partial { color: #7a5500; }
  .hist-card.newest { border-color: var(--sage-dark); background: #f8fdf9; }
  .hist-card.newest::before { content: 'Latest'; display: block; grid-column: 1 / -1; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em; color: var(--sage-dark); margin-bottom: 0.45rem; }

  /* ── DESKTOP ≥ 600px ── */
  @media (min-width: 600px) {
    html, body { overflow-x: auto; }
    header { padding: 1rem 1.75rem; gap: 1rem; }
    header h1 { font-size: 1.4rem; flex-shrink: 0; } /* enough room; stop shrinking h1 */
    .header-meta { gap: 0.75rem; }
    .btn-history-header { flex-shrink: 0; } /* enough room; stop shrinking button */
    .time-display .t-label { display: block; }
    .time-display .clock   { font-size: 1.05rem; }
    .weather-badge .wb-text { display: inline; margin-left: 0.2rem; }
    .phase { padding: 1.75rem 1.5rem; }
    .section-title { font-size: 1.3rem; }
    .goal-options { flex-direction: row; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 0.7rem; }
    .goal-card { flex-direction: column; gap: 0; }
    .goal-icon { font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
    .goal-name { font-size: 0.9rem; }
    .goal-desc { font-size: 0.74rem; }
    .preset-options { flex-direction: row; }
    .preset-btn { flex: 1; }
    .produce-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(175px, 1fr)); gap: 0.85rem; }
    .produce-emoji { font-size: 1.9rem; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; }
    .produce-name  { font-size: 0.95rem; }
    .produce-hint  { font-size: 0.75rem; }
    .produce-cost  { font-size: 0.8rem; }
    .lineup-stack      { display: none; }
    .lineup-table-wrap { display: block; }
    .market-layout { flex-direction: row; align-items: start; }
    .market-main   { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
    .stats-panel   { width: 270px; flex-shrink: 0; position: sticky; top: 68px; }
    .btn-full { display: inline-block; width: auto; }
  }

  /* ── DESKTOP TABLE (hidden mobile, shown ≥600px) ── */
  .lineup-table-wrap { display: none; }
  table.price-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.88rem; }
  table.price-table th { text-align: left; padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  table.price-table td { padding: 0.4rem 0.5rem; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border); color: var(--ink-soft); vertical-align: middle; }
  table.price-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

<script>

const GOALS = {
  profit: {
    label:'💰 Turn a Profit', shortLabel:'💰 Profit',
    focusBoxId:'rbox-profit', progressLabel:'Profit target',
    progressOf(s) { return Math.min(Math.max((s.profit + 20) / 50, 0), 1); },
    grade(s) {
      const p = s.profit;
      if (p >= 50)  return { emoji:'🌟', headline:'Incredible margins!',   verdictClass:'met',     verdict:'Goal met — handsome profit',      summary:`You turned $${p.toFixed(2)} net profit. Pricing strategy paid off.` };
      if (p >= 20)  return { emoji:'🌻', headline:'Profitable day!',       verdictClass:'met',     verdict:'Goal met — solidly in the black', summary:`$${p.toFixed(2)} net profit. The booth is working.` };
      if (p >= 1)   return { emoji:'🌾', headline:'Just scraped by.',      verdictClass:'partial', verdict:'Barely profitable',               summary:`Only $${p.toFixed(2)} profit. A closer run than it needed to be.` };
      if (p >= -10) return { emoji:'☁️', headline:'Break-even territory.', verdictClass:'partial', verdict:'Goal missed — near break-even',   summary:`$${Math.abs(p).toFixed(2)} short of profit. Tighten quantities next time.` };
      return         { emoji:'🥀', headline:'Tough day at the booth.',     verdictClass:'missed',  verdict:'Goal missed — took a loss',       summary:`Lost $${Math.abs(p).toFixed(2)} today. Revisit pricing or reduce overstock.` };
    },
  },
  sellthrough: {
    label:'🧺 Empty the Booth', shortLabel:'🧺 Sell-through',
    focusBoxId:'rbox-sellthrough', progressLabel:'Sell-through target (85%)',
    progressOf(s) { return Math.min(s.sellPct / 85, 1); },
    grade(s) {

      if (pct >= 50) return { emoji:'☁️', headline:'Half left behind.',    verdictClass:'missed',  verdict:'Goal missed — too much unsold',           summary:`Only ${pct.toFixed(0)}% sold through. Try lower prices or smaller quantities.` };

  freshness:   ['Buying fewer units keeps waste low — set your max qty conservatively.','Items priced near fair value sell through fast and rarely leave orphan stock.',"If an item is sitting at 5+ unsold by 11 AM, it's at risk of hitting your waste limit.","Berries and herbs spoil fastest — never over-order them if freshness is the goal."],
};

let selectedGoal = 'profit';

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   LOCALSTORAGE
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function loadHistory() {
  try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY) || '[]'); } catch(e) { return []; }
}
function saveRun(record) {
  try { const h = loadHistory(); h.unshift(record); localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify(h)); updateHistCount(); } catch(e) {}
}
function clearHistory() {
  try { localStorage.removeItem(LS_KEY); } catch(e) {}
  updateHistCount();
}
function updateHistCount() {
  const n = loadHistory().length;
  const el = document.getElementById('hist-count');
  el.textContent   = n;
  el.style.display = n > 0 ? '' : 'none';
}
function confirmClearHistory() {
  if (!confirm('Clear all saved market days? This cannot be undone.')) return;
  clearHistory(); renderHistory();
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   HISTORY RENDER
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderHistory() {
  const hist    = loadHistory();
  const sumWrap = document.getElementById('history-summary-wrap');
  const listEl  = document.getElementById('history-list');
  if (hist.length === 0) {
    sumWrap.innerHTML = '';
    listEl.innerHTML  = `<div class="history-empty"><div class="empty-icon">📋</div><p>No market days saved yet.<br>Complete a run and results will appear here.</p></div>`;
    return;
  }
  const n           = hist.length;
  const totalProfit = hist.reduce((a,r) => a + r.profit, 0);
  const avgSell     = hist.reduce((a,r) => a + r.sellPct, 0) / n;
  const metGoal     = hist.filter(r => r.verdictClass === 'met').length;
  const best        = [...hist].sort((a,b) => b.profit - a.profit)[0];
  sumWrap.innerHTML = `
    <div class="history-summary">
      <div class="hs-box"><div class="hs-label">Total runs</div><div class="hs-value">${n}</div></div>
      <div class="hs-box"><div class="hs-label">Cumulative profit</div><div class="hs-value ${totalProfit >= 0 ? 'pos' : 'neg'}">${totalProfit >= 0 ? '+' : '–'}$${Math.abs(totalProfit).toFixed(2)}</div></div>
      <div class="hs-box"><div class="hs-label">Avg sell-through</div><div class="hs-value">${avgSell.toFixed(0)}%</div></div>
      <div class="hs-box"><div class="hs-label">Goals met</div><div class="hs-value">${metGoal} / ${n}</div></div>
      <div class="hs-box"><div class="hs-label">Best profit day</div><div class="hs-value pos">+$${Math.max(0, best.profit).toFixed(2)}</div></div>
    </div>`;
  listEl.innerHTML = hist.map((r, idx) => {
    const pp  = r.profit >= 0;
    const wCl = r.weatherId || 'sunny';
    return `

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   GOAL SELECTION

function selectGoal(id) {

  ['profit','sellthrough','freshness'].forEach(g =>
    document.getElementById('goal-' + g).classList.toggle('selected', g === id)
  );
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   PRESETS
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function applyPreset(key) {
  const preset = PRESETS[key];
  if (!preset) return;

  /* Set goal */
  selectGoal(preset.goal);

  /* Clear current selection */
  selectedIds.forEach(id => {
    const el = document.getElementById('pc-' + id);
    if (el) el.classList.remove('selected');
  });
  selectedIds = new Set();

  /* Select each preset item */
  preset.items.forEach(item => {
    selectedIds.add(item.id);
    const el = document.getElementById('pc-' + item.id);
    if (el) el.classList.add('selected');
  });

  /* Render the lineup, then override values */
  updateSetupTable();

  /* After DOM is updated, set the preset qty/price values */
  preset.items.forEach(item => {
    syncMirror('qty',   item.id, item.qty);
    syncMirror('price', item.id, item.price.toFixed(2));
  });

  recalcCost();

  /* Scroll gently to the lineup */
  const wrap = document.getElementById('setup-table-wrap');
  if (wrap) setTimeout(() => wrap.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'nearest' }), 100);
}

              <input class="stepper-val" type="number" id="price-${p.id}" value="${p.suggestPrice.toFixed(2)}" min="0.10" step="0.05" onchange="clampAndSync('price-${p.id}',0.10,99.99); recalcCost();" inputmode="decimal">
              <button class="stepper-btn" onclick="stepPrice('price-${p.id}',+0.05)">+</button>
            </div>
            <div class="li-fair-hint">Fair: $${p.suggestPrice.toFixed(2)} <span class="suggestion-tag">fair</span></div>

/* Stepper helpers */
function stepVal(inputId, delta, min, max) {
  const el = document.getElementById(inputId);
  if (!el) return;
  const val = Math.min(max, Math.max(min, (parseInt(el.value) || 0) + delta));
  el.value = val;
  if (inputId.startsWith('qty-') && !inputId.startsWith('qty-d-')) syncMirror('qty', inputId.replace('qty-',''), val);
  recalcCost();
}
function stepPrice(inputId, delta) {
  const el = document.getElementById(inputId);
  if (!el) return;
  const val = Math.max(0.10, Math.round((parseFloat(el.value) + delta) * 100) / 100);
  el.value = val.toFixed(2);
  syncMirror('price', inputId.replace('price-',''), val.toFixed(2));
  recalcCost();
}
function clampAndSync(inputId, min, max) {
  const el = document.getElementById(inputId);
  if (!el) return;
  const isPrice = inputId.startsWith('price-');
  let val = isPrice ? parseFloat(el.value) : parseInt(el.value);
  val = isNaN(val) ? min : Math.min(max, Math.max(min, val));
  el.value = isPrice ? val.toFixed(2) : val;
  syncMirror(isPrice ? 'price' : 'qty', inputId.replace('price-','').replace('qty-',''), el.value);
}
function syncMirror(type, id, value) {
  const mEl = document.getElementById(`${type}-${id}`);
  const dEl = document.getElementById(`${type}-d-${id}`);
  if (mEl && String(mEl.value) !== String(value)) mEl.value = value;
  if (dEl && String(dEl.value) !== String(value)) dEl.value = value;
}
function removeProduce(id) {
  selectedIds.delete(id);
  document.getElementById('pc-' + id).classList.remove('selected');
  updateSetupTable();
}
function recalcCost() {
  let cost = 0;
  for (const id of selectedIds) {
    const p   = PRODUCE.find(x => x.id === id);
    const qEl = document.getElementById('qty-' + id) || document.getElementById('qty-d-' + id);
    cost += (qEl ? (parseInt(qEl.value) || p.defaultQty) : p.defaultQty) * p.costPer;
  }
  totalCost = cost;
  document.getElementById('total-cost-display').textContent = '$' + cost.toFixed(2);
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   OPEN BOOTH
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function openBooth() {
  const err = document.getElementById('setup-error');
  if (selectedIds.size < 2) { err.textContent = 'Pick at least 2 items.'; return; }
  err.textContent = '';
  boothItems = [...selectedIds].map(id => {
    const p     = PRODUCE.find(x => x.id === id);
    const qEl   = document.getElementById('qty-'   + id) || document.getElementById('qty-d-'   + id);
    const pEl   = document.getElementById('price-' + id) || document.getElementById('price-d-' + id);
    const qty   = qEl ? (parseInt(qEl.value)   || p.defaultQty)   : p.defaultQty;
    const price = pEl ? (parseFloat(pEl.value) || p.suggestPrice) : p.suggestPrice;
    return { ...p, qty, price, sold: 0 };
  });
  currentHour  = MARKET_OPEN;
  totalRevenue = 0;
  logEntries   = [];
  gameRunning  = true;
  const goalDef = GOALS[selectedGoal];
  document.getElementById('market-goal-badge').innerHTML = `<span class="goal-badge">${goalDef.label}</span>`;
  document.getElementById('goal-prog-label').textContent  = goalDef.progressLabel;
  ensureWasteBox();
  setWeatherStrip();
  renderBoothItems();
  updateStats();
  renderLog();
  showPhase('phase-market');
  updateTimeDisplay();
  addLog('open',  `🌅 Booth is open! ${boothItems.length} items ready to sell.`);
  addLog('event', `${weather.icon} ${weather.label} — ${ weather.id === 'rainy' ? 'Lighter crowd expected today.' : weather.id === 'sunny' ? 'Perfect selling weather.' : 'Normal turnout.' }`);
  randomTip();
}
function ensureWasteBox() {
  if (!document.getElementById('rbox-waste')) {
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    box.className = 'result-box'; box.id = 'rbox-waste';
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="rb-label">Max waste / item</div><div class="rb-value" id="res-waste">—</div>';
    document.getElementById('results-grid').appendChild(box);
  }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   MARKET MECHANICS
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function hourDemand(hour) {
  return ({ 8:1.5, 9:1.8, 10:1.3, 11:1.0, 12:0.7 }[hour] || 1.0) * weather.trafficMod;
}
function itemDemand(item, hour) {
  const fairness    = item.suggestPrice / Math.max(item.price, 0.01);
  const demandScore = Math.min(Math.max(fairness, 0.3), 2.2);
  const base        = 0.12 * demandScore * hourDemand(hour) * weather.demandMod;
  const remaining   = item.qty - item.sold;
  const raw         = base * remaining;
  return Math.max(0, Math.round(raw + (Math.random() - 0.5) * raw * 0.5));
}
function doTick() {
  if (!gameRunning || currentHour >= MARKET_CLOSE) return;
  const hour = currentHour;
  let soldThisHour = 0;
  for (const item of boothItems) {
    const remaining = item.qty - item.sold;
    if (remaining <= 0) continue;
    const sales = Math.min(itemDemand(item, hour), remaining);
    if (sales > 0) {
      item.sold += sales; totalRevenue += sales * item.price; soldThisHour += sales;
      addLog('sale', `${item.emoji} Sold ${sales} ${item.unit}${sales > 1 ? 's' : ''} of ${item.name} @ $${item.price.toFixed(2)}`);
    }
  }
  if (soldThisHour === 0) addLog('event', '🚶 Quiet stretch — nobody stopped at the booth this hour.');
  if (boothItems.every(i => i.qty === i.sold)) { addLog('sale','🎉 Sold out of everything! Packing up early.'); endMarket(); return; }
  currentHour++;
  updateTimeDisplay(); renderBoothItems(); updateStats(); renderLog();
  if (currentHour >= MARKET_CLOSE) { addLog('event','🔔 1 PM — market closing time. Packing up.'); endMarket(); }
  else randomTip();
}
function fastForward() { while (gameRunning && currentHour < MARKET_CLOSE) doTick(); }
function endMarket() {
  gameRunning = false;
  document.getElementById('tick-btn').disabled = true;
  document.getElementById('fast-btn').disabled = true;
  renderLog();
  setTimeout(() => showResults(), 900);
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   RENDER HELPERS
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderBoothItems() {
  document.getElementById('booth-items-display').innerHTML = boothItems.map(item => {
    const remaining = item.qty - item.sold;
    const pct = remaining / item.qty;
    const cls = remaining === 0 ? 'sold-out' : pct < 0.25 ? 'selling-out' : '';
    const tag = remaining === 0 ? '🚫 Sold out' : pct < 0.25 ? '⚡ Almost gone' : `${remaining} left`;
    return `<div class="booth-item ${cls}"><span class="item-emoji">${item.emoji}</span><div class="item-info"><div class="item-name">${item.name}</div><div class="item-price">$${item.price.toFixed(2)} / ${item.unit}</div><div class="item-stock">${tag}</div></div></div>`;
  }).join('');
}
function buildStats() {
  const soldTotal  = boothItems.reduce((a,b) => a + b.sold, 0);
  const totalUnits = boothItems.reduce((a,b) => a + b.qty,  0);
  const profit     = totalRevenue - totalCost;
  const sellPct    = totalUnits > 0 ? (soldTotal / totalUnits * 100) : 0;
  const maxWaste   = boothItems.reduce((a,b) => Math.max(a, b.qty - b.sold), 0);
  const sorted     = [...boothItems].sort((a,b) => (b.sold*b.price) - (a.sold*a.price));
  const best       = sorted[0];
  const worst      = sorted[sorted.length - 1];
  return { soldTotal, totalUnits, profit, sellPct, maxWaste, best, worst, items: boothItems };
}
function updateStats() {
  const s = buildStats();
  document.getElementById('live-revenue').textContent = '$' + totalRevenue.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('live-cost').textContent    = '$' + totalCost.toFixed(2);
  const pEl = document.getElementById('live-profit');
  pEl.textContent = (s.profit >= 0 ? '+$' : '-$') + Math.abs(s.profit).toFixed(2);
  pEl.classList.toggle('green', s.profit >= 0);
  pEl.classList.toggle('red',   s.profit < 0);
  document.getElementById('live-sold').textContent   = s.soldTotal;
  document.getElementById('live-remain').textContent = s.totalUnits - s.soldTotal;
  document.getElementById('progress-fill').style.width = Math.min(((currentHour - MARKET_OPEN) / HOURS) * 100, 100) + '%';
  const frac = GOALS[selectedGoal].progressOf(s);
  document.getElementById('goal-fill').style.width     = Math.round(frac * 100) + '%';
  document.getElementById('goal-prog-pct').textContent = Math.round(frac * 100) + '%';
}
function addLog(type, msg) { logEntries.push({ type, msg, time: fmtHour(currentHour) }); }
function renderLog() {
  document.getElementById('log-feed').innerHTML = [...logEntries].reverse().map(e => {
    const cls = e.type === 'sale' ? 'log-sale' : e.type === 'bad' ? 'log-bad' : 'log-event';
    return `<div class="log-entry"><span class="log-time">${e.time}</span><span class="${cls}">${e.msg}</span></div>`;
  }).join('');
}
function randomTip() {
  const pool = TIPS[selectedGoal] || TIPS.profit;
  document.getElementById('tip-card').innerHTML = `<strong>Tip</strong>${pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)]}`;
}
function updateTimeDisplay() {
  const t = fmtHour(currentHour);
  document.getElementById('time-label').textContent  = t;
  document.getElementById('header-time').textContent = t;
}
function fmtHour(h) {
  if (h === 12) return '12:00 PM';
  if (h === 13) return '1:00 PM';
  return h + ':00 ' + (h < 12 ? 'AM' : 'PM');
}
function setWeatherStrip() {
  const el = document.getElementById('weather-strip-display');
  el.className = 'weather-strip ' + weather.id;
  el.innerHTML = `<span class="weather-icon">${weather.icon}</span><span>${weather.strip}</span>`;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   BOOTH REPORT  (plain-text, copyable)
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function buildReport(s, g, dateStr) {
  const pad  = (str, w) => String(str).padEnd(w);
  const rpad = (str, w) => String(str).padStart(w);
  const line = '─'.repeat(40);
  const goalDef = GOALS[selectedGoal];

  /* Item lines */
  const itemLines = boothItems.map(item => {
    const rev     = item.sold * item.price;
    const cost    = item.qty  * item.costPer;
    const net     = rev - cost;
    const pct     = item.qty > 0 ? Math.round(item.sold / item.qty * 100) : 0;
    const netStr  = (net >= 0 ? '+$' : '-$') + Math.abs(net).toFixed(2);
    return `  ${item.emoji} ${pad(item.name, 22)} ${rpad(item.sold+'/'+item.qty, 6)} ${rpad(pct+'%', 5)} ${rpad(netStr, 8)}`;
  }).join('\n');

  const profitStr = (s.profit >= 0 ? '+$' : '-$') + Math.abs(s.profit).toFixed(2);

  return [
    '🌿 THE MARKET BOOTH — Day Report',
    line,
    `Date:        ${dateStr}`,
    `Weather:     ${weather.icon} ${weather.label}`,
    `Goal:        ${goalDef.label}`,
    '',
    `Grade:       ${g.emoji} ${g.headline}`,
    `Verdict:     ${g.verdict}`,
    '',
    line,
    `Revenue:     $${totalRevenue.toFixed(2)}`,
    `Wholesale:   $${totalCost.toFixed(2)}`,
    `Net profit:  ${profitStr}`,
    `Sell-through: ${s.sellPct.toFixed(0)}%  (${s.soldTotal} / ${s.totalUnits} units)`,
    '',
    line,
    `  ${'Item'.padEnd(24)} ${'Sold'.padEnd(6)} ${'%'.padEnd(5)} ${'Net'}`,
    '  ' + '─'.repeat(38),
    itemLines,
    '',
    `Best seller:  ${s.best  ? s.best.emoji  + ' ' + s.best.name  : '—'}`,
    `Worst seller: ${s.worst ? s.worst.emoji + ' ' + s.worst.name : '—'}`,
    line,
    '— Green Hill Farm · The Market Booth sim',
  ].join('\n');
}

function copyReport() {
  const ta  = document.getElementById('report-ta');
  const btn = document.getElementById('copy-btn');
  const text = ta.value;
  if (!text) return;

  function flash() {
    btn.textContent = 'Copied ✓';
    btn.classList.add('copied');
    setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = 'Copy report'; btn.classList.remove('copied'); }, 1600);
  }

  if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(flash).catch(() => {
      ta.select(); try { document.execCommand('copy'); flash(); } catch(e) {}
    });
  } else {
    ta.select(); try { document.execCommand('copy'); flash(); } catch(e) {}
  }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESULTS
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function showResults() {
  const s       = buildStats();
  const goalDef = GOALS[selectedGoal];
  const g       = goalDef.grade(s);

  const now     = new Date();
  const dateStr = now.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month:'short', day:'numeric', year:'numeric' })
                + ' ' + now.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, { hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit' });
  saveRun({
    date: dateStr, goal: selectedGoal, goalLabel: goalDef.label, goalShortLabel: goalDef.shortLabel,
    weatherId: weather.id, weatherIcon: weather.icon, weatherLabel: weather.label,
    profit: s.profit, sellPct: s.sellPct,
    gradeEmoji: g.emoji, headline: g.headline, verdict: g.verdict, verdictClass: g.verdictClass,
  });

  document.getElementById('result-grade').textContent      = g.emoji;
  document.getElementById('result-headline').textContent   = g.headline;
  document.getElementById('result-summary').textContent    = g.summary;
  document.getElementById('result-goal-verdict').innerHTML = `<span class="goal-verdict ${g.verdictClass}">${g.verdict}</span>`;
  document.getElementById('res-revenue').textContent       = '$' + totalRevenue.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('res-cost').textContent          = '$' + totalCost.toFixed(2);
  const profEl = document.getElementById('res-profit');
  profEl.textContent = (s.profit >= 0 ? '+$' : '-$') + Math.abs(s.profit).toFixed(2);
  profEl.className   = 'rb-value ' + (s.profit >= 0 ? 'profit' : 'loss');
  document.getElementById('res-sold').textContent        = s.soldTotal + ' units';
  document.getElementById('res-sellthrough').textContent = s.sellPct.toFixed(0) + '%';
  document.getElementById('res-best').textContent        = s.best ? s.best.emoji + ' ' + s.best.name : '—';
  if (document.getElementById('res-waste')) document.getElementById('res-waste').textContent = s.maxWaste + ' units';

  document.querySelectorAll('.result-box').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('goal-focus'));
  const fBox = document.getElementById(goalDef.focusBoxId);
  if (fBox) fBox.classList.add('goal-focus');

  document.getElementById('breakdown-rows').innerHTML = boothItems.map(item => {
    const rev        = item.sold * item.price;
    const cost       = item.qty  * item.costPer;
    const itemProfit = rev - cost;
    const unsold     = item.qty - item.sold;
    const wFlag = (selectedGoal === 'freshness' && unsold > 3)
      ? `<span style="font-size:0.7rem;color:var(--tomato);margin-left:3px;">⚠ ${unsold} unsold</span>` : '';
    return `
      <div class="brow">
        <div class="bname">${item.emoji} ${item.name}${wFlag}</div>
        <div class="bsold">${item.sold}/${item.qty}</div>
        <div class="${itemProfit >= 0 ? 'brevenue' : 'bloss'}">${itemProfit >= 0 ? '+' : '–'}$${Math.abs(itemProfit).toFixed(2)}</div>
      </div>`;
  }).join('');

  /* Populate booth report textarea */
  document.getElementById('report-ta').value = buildReport(s, g, dateStr);
  /* Reset copy button state */
  const btn = document.getElementById('copy-btn');
  btn.textContent = 'Copy report';
  btn.classList.remove('copied');

  showPhase('phase-results');
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESET
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function resetGame() {
  selectedGoal = 'profit';
  selectedIds  = new Set();
  boothItems   = [];
  currentHour  = MARKET_OPEN;
  totalRevenue = 0;
  totalCost    = 0;
  logEntries   = [];
  gameRunning  = false;
  document.getElementById('tick-btn').disabled = false;
  document.getElementById('fast-btn').disabled = false;
  document.getElementById('header-time').textContent = '8:00 AM';
  ['profit','sellthrough','freshness'].forEach(g =>
    document.getElementById('goal-' + g).classList.toggle('selected', g === 'profit')
  );
  weather = WEATHERS[Math.floor(Math.random() * WEATHERS.length)];
  document.getElementById('hdr-weather-icon').textContent = weather.icon;
  document.getElementById('hdr-weather-text').textContent = ' ' + weather.label;
  renderProduceGrid();
  document.getElementById('setup-table-wrap').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('select-prompt').style.display    = 'block';
  showPhase('phase-setup');
}

function showPhase(id) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.phase').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('active');
  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
}

init();
</script>
</body>
</html>
